sentences.zh: 鄭嶽，字汝華，莆田人。

translations.literal: Zheng Yue, style name Ruhua, was a native of Putian.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yue, styled Ruhua, was from Putian.

sentences.zh: 弘治六年進士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongzhi he passed the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a metropolitan graduate in the sixth year of the Hongzhi reign (1493).

sentences.zh: 授戶部主事，改刑部主事。

translations.literal: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue and transferred to a secretaryship in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue, then transferred to the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 董天錫偕錦衣千戶張福決囚，福坐天錫上，嶽言其非體。

translations.literal: Dong Tianxi together with Zhang Fu, a chiliarch of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, judged prisoners; Fu was seated above Tianxi; Yue said this was improper in form.
translations.idiomatic: When Dong Tianxi and Zhang Fu, a chiliarch of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, jointly tried prisoners, Fu was seated above Tianxi; Yue protested that this violated proper protocol.

sentences.zh: 且言：「糾劾非鎮監職，而董讓行之。

translations.literal: Moreover he said: "Impeachment is not the duty of frontier eunuch supervisors, yet Dong is allowed to carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Impeachment is not the duty of frontier eunuch supervisors, yet Dong is permitted to conduct it.

sentences.zh: 太常本禮部屬，而崔誌端專之。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices is originally subordinate to the Ministry of Rites, yet Cui Zhiduan monopolizes it.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices is subordinate to the Ministry of Rites, yet Cui Zhiduan monopolizes its affairs.

sentences.zh: 內外效尤，益無忌憚」。

translations.literal: Within and without all imitate this, growing ever more unbridled."
translations.idiomatic: Inside and outside the court others follow suit, growing ever more brazen."

sentences.zh: 忤旨，系獄。

translations.literal: He offended the imperial will and was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: He offended the emperor and was thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 尚書周經、侍郎許進等救，不聽。

translations.literal: Minister Zhou Jing, Vice Minister Xu Jin, and others interceded, but the emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Zhou Jing, Vice Minister Xu Jin, and others pleaded for him, but the emperor refused to listen.

sentences.zh: 贖杖還職。

translations.literal: He redeemed his punishment by caning and returned to office.
translations.idiomatic: After paying a fine in lieu of corporal punishment, he returned to his post.

sentences.zh: 尋進員外郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to vice director.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to vice director.

sentences.zh: 許進督師大同，貴近惡其剛方，議代之。

translations.literal: Xu Jin supervised the army at Datong; the powerful near the throne hated his stern integrity and discussed replacing him.
translations.idiomatic: When Xu Jin commanded the army at Datong, court favorites resented his stern integrity and plotted to replace him.

sentences.zh: 罷職總兵官趙袴謀起用，京軍屢出無功。

translations.literal: The dismissed regional commander Zhao Ku schemed for reinstatement; capital troops had repeatedly been sent out without success.
translations.idiomatic: The dismissed regional commander Zhao Ku sought reinstatement, while capital troops had been sent out repeatedly without success.

sentences.zh: 嶽言進不可代，袴不可用，京軍不可出。

translations.literal: Yue said Jin must not be replaced, Ku must not be employed, and capital troops must not be sent out.
translations.idiomatic: Yue argued that Jin must not be replaced, that Ku must not be reappointed, and that capital troops must not be deployed again.

sentences.zh: 朝論韙之。

translations.literal: Court opinion approved his views.
translations.idiomatic: Court opinion sided with him.

sentences.zh: 遷湖廣僉事，歸宗藩侵地於民。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be a vice commissioner in Huguang and restored to the people land seized by princely estates.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Huguang as vice commissioner, he restored to commoners lands seized by princely estates.

sentences.zh: 施州夷民相仇殺者，有司以叛告。

translations.literal: Where Yi people of Shizhou feuded and killed one another, local officials reported rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: When Yi communities in Shizhou feuded and killed one another, local officials reported them as rebels.

sentences.zh: 嶽擒治其魁，余悉縱遣。

translations.literal: Yue seized and punished the ringleaders and released all the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Yue arrested and punished the ringleaders and released all the rest.

sentences.zh: 荊、嶽饑，勸富民出粟，馳河泊禁。

translations.literal: Jing and Yue suffered famine; he urged wealthy households to release grain and urgently lifted bans on river fisheries.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing and Yue prefectures suffered famine, he urged wealthy households to release grain and urgently lifted bans on river fisheries.

sentences.zh: 屬縣輸糧遠衛，率二石致一石。

translations.literal: Subordinate counties transported grain to distant guards; on average two piculs delivered only one.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate counties shipped grain to distant guards, and on average only one picul arrived for every two sent.

sentences.zh: 嶽以其直給衛，而留粟備振，民乃獲濟。

translations.literal: Yue paid the guards in cash and retained the grain for relief stores, and the people were thereby saved.
translations.idiomatic: Yue paid the guards in cash instead, kept the grain for relief stores, and the people were thereby saved.

sentences.zh: 正德初，擢廣西副使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhengde he was promoted to vice commissioner of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhengde reign he was promoted to vice commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 土官岑猛當徙福建，據田州不肯徙。

translations.literal: The native official Cen Meng was to be relocated to Fujian but held Tianzhou and refused to move.
translations.idiomatic: The native official Cen Meng was ordered to relocate to Fujian, but he held Tianzhou and refused to move.

sentences.zh: 嶽許為奏改近地，猛乃請自效。

translations.literal: Yue promised to memorialize for a transfer to a nearer place; Meng then offered to serve on his own initiative.
translations.idiomatic: Yue promised to petition for reassignment to a nearer region, whereupon Meng volunteered his service.

sentences.zh: 尋改廣東。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 遷江西按察使，就遷左布政使。

translations.literal: He was moved to be surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi and then directly promoted to left administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He became surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi and was then promoted directly to left administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 宸濠奪民田億萬計，民立砦自保。

translations.literal: Prince Chen Hao seized hundreds of millions in commoners' fields; the people built stockades to protect themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chen Hao seized vast tracts of commoners' land, and the people built stockades to defend themselves.

sentences.zh: 宸濠欲兵之，嶽持不可。

translations.literal: Chen Hao wished to send troops against them; Yue held that this must not be done.
translations.idiomatic: When Chen Hao wanted to send troops against them, Yue insisted that he must not.

sentences.zh: 會提學副使李夢陽與巡按御史江萬實相訐，嶽承檄按之。

translations.literal: It happened that the education vice commissioner Li Mengyang and the touring censor Jiang Wanshi accused each other; Yue received orders to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: When education vice commissioner Li Mengyang and touring censor Jiang Wanshi accused each other, Yue was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 夢陽執嶽親信吏，言嶽子澐受賕，欲因以脅嶽。

translations.literal: Mengyang seized Yue's trusted clerk and said Yue's son Yun had taken bribes, intending thereby to coerce Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Mengyang seized Yue's trusted clerk, alleging that Yue's son Yun had taken bribes, hoping thereby to coerce Yue.

sentences.zh: 宸濠因助夢陽奏其事，囚掠澐。

translations.literal: Chen Hao thereupon aided Mengyang in memorializing the matter and imprisoned and tortured Yun.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hao then backed Mengyang's memorial and imprisoned and tortured Yun.

sentences.zh: 巡撫任漢顧慮不能決，帝遣大理卿燕忠會給事中黎奭按問。

translations.literal: Grand coordinator Ren Han hesitated and could not decide; the emperor sent the chief justice of the Court of Judicial Review Yan Zhong together with the supervising secretary Li Yi to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Grand coordinator Ren Han could not decide the case, so the emperor sent chief justice Yan Zhong and supervising secretary Li Yi to conduct an inquiry.

sentences.zh: 忠等奏勘嶽子私有跡，而夢陽挾制撫、按，俱宜斥。

translations.literal: Zhong and others memorialized that investigation showed traces of private gain by Yue's son, while Mengyang coerced the grand coordinator and censors; all should be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong and his colleagues reported traces of private gain involving Yue's son, and that Mengyang had coerced the grand coordinator and censors; all should be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 嶽遂奪官為民。

translations.literal: Yue was thereupon stripped of office and reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Yue was stripped of office and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 宸濠敗，中外交薦，起四川布政使。

translations.literal: When Chen Hao was defeated, court and region alike recommended him; he was recalled as administration commissioner of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: After Chen Hao's defeat, officials inside and outside the court recommended him, and he was recalled as administration commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 以憂不赴。

translations.literal: Because of mourning he did not take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He did not take up the appointment because he was in mourning.

sentences.zh: 劉玉，字鹹栗，萬安人。

translations.literal: Liu Yu, style name Xianli, was a native of Wan'an.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, styled Xianli, was from Wan'an.

sentences.zh: 祖廣衡，永樂末進士。

translations.literal: His grandfather Guangheng was a metropolitan graduate at the end of Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Liu Guangheng became a metropolitan graduate at the end of the Yongle reign.

sentences.zh: 正統間，以刑部郎中出修浙江荒政，積粟數百萬，督治陂塘為旱澇備。

translations.literal: During Zhengtong, as a director in the Ministry of Justice he went out to manage famine relief in Zhejiang, amassed several million piculs of grain, and supervised repair of reservoirs and ponds as preparation against drought and flood.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengtong reign, as a director in the Ministry of Justice he went to manage famine relief in Zhejiang, stockpiled millions of piculs of grain, and oversaw repair of reservoirs and ponds against drought and flood.

sentences.zh: 景泰初，歷左副都御史，鎮守陜西。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingtai he served as left vice censor-in-chief and guarded Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jingtai reign he served as left vice censor-in-chief and guarded Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 請遇災傷，毋俟勘報，即除其賦，庶有司不得借覆核陰行科率，從之。

translations.literal: He requested that when disaster or crop failure occurred, one need not wait for investigation and report but should immediately remit taxes, so that local officials could not use re-verification as a pretext for covert exactions; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He petitioned that when disaster struck, taxes should be remitted at once without waiting for investigation, so local officials could not use re-verification as a pretext for covert exactions; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 還治院事。

translations.literal: He returned to administer affairs of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to administer affairs at the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 福建、浙江盜起，命往督兵捕。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Fujian and Zhejiang; he was ordered to go supervise troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits rose in Fujian and Zhejiang, he was ordered to supervise troops in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 議創壽寧縣於官臺山，以清盜窟。

translations.literal: He proposed creating Shouning County at Guantai Mountain to clear out bandit lairs.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed creating Shouning County at Guantai Mountain to eliminate bandit strongholds.

sentences.zh: 討平處州賊。

translations.literal: He campaigned and pacified the bandits of Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned and pacified the bandits of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 已，復巡撫遼東。

translations.literal: Later he again served as grand coordinator of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Later he again served as grand coordinator of Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 居官以廉節稱。

translations.literal: In office he was known for integrity and frugality.
translations.idiomatic: In office he was known for integrity and frugality.

sentences.zh: 終刑部尚書。

translations.literal: He ended as minister of justice.
translations.idiomatic: He ended his career as minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 父喬，成化初進士。

translations.literal: His father Qiao was a metropolitan graduate at the beginning of Chenghua.
translations.idiomatic: His father Liu Qiao became a metropolitan graduate early in the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 累官湖廣左布政使。

translations.literal: He rose through offices to left administration commissioner of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to left administration commissioner of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 玉登弘治九年進士，授輝縣知縣。

translations.literal: Yu passed the metropolitan examination in the ninth year of Hongzhi and was appointed magistrate of Huixian.
translations.idiomatic: Yu became a metropolitan graduate in the ninth year of Hongzhi (1496) and was appointed magistrate of Huixian.

sentences.zh: 發粟振饑，奏蠲虛稅，復業者千家。

translations.literal: He distributed grain to relieve famine, memorialized to remit fictitious taxes, and a thousand households resumed their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: He distributed grain to relieve famine, petitioned to remit fictitious taxes, and a thousand households resumed their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 擢御史。

translations.literal: He was promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to censor.

sentences.zh: 初，孫伯堅、金琦、王寧皆以傳奉得官，已，又以指揮胡震為都指揮，分守通州。

translations.literal: Earlier Sun Bojian, Jin Qi, and Wang Ning had all received office through special imperial transmission; later the commander Hu Zhen was also made regional commander and assigned to guard Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Sun Bojian, Jin Qi, and Wang Ning had all received office through special imperial transmission; later the commander Hu Zhen was also made regional commander and assigned to guard Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 玉抗疏言：「傳奉不已，繼之內批，累聖德，乞皆罷之。

translations.literal: Yu submitted a forceful memorial saying: "Special transmissions do not cease, followed by inner rescripts; this burdens sagely virtue; I beg that all be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Yu submitted a forceful memorial: "Special transmissions never cease, followed by inner rescripts; this burdens the emperor's virtue; I beg that all such appointments be abolished.

sentences.zh: 」不納。

translations.literal: " His plea was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: " His plea was not accepted.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，召為左僉都御史。

translations.literal: When the Shizong Emperor ascended the throne, Yu was summoned as left vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shizong Emperor ascended the throne, Yu was summoned as left vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 論遏亂功，進右副都御史。

translations.literal: For merit in checking disorder he was advanced to right vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in quelling disorder he was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年改左。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing he was transferred to the left post.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiajing (1522) he was transferred to the left post.

sentences.zh: 歷刑部左、右侍郎。

translations.literal: He served successively as left and right vice minister of justice.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as left and right vice minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 初，偕九卿爭興獻帝不宜稱皇，及帝欲考獻帝，又偕廷臣伏闕哭爭。

translations.literal: Earlier he had joined the nine ministers in contending that the Xingxian Emperor ought not be styled emperor; when the emperor wished to honor the Xingxian Emperor as his forebear, he again joined court officials in prostrating themselves at the palace gate and weeping in protest.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier he had joined the nine ministers in arguing that the Xingxian Emperor ought not be styled emperor; when the emperor wished to honor his father as imperial forebear, Yu again joined court officials in weeping and protesting at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 六年秋坐李福達獄削籍，卒於家。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the sixth year he was struck from the rolls because of the Li Fuda case and died at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the sixth year he was struck from the rolls in the Li Fuda case and died at home.

sentences.zh: 玉所居僅庇風雨。

translations.literal: Yu's dwelling barely sheltered him from wind and rain.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's dwelling barely kept out wind and rain.

sentences.zh: 天文、地理、兵制、刑律皆有論著。

translations.literal: On astronomy, geography, military institutions, and penal law he had treatises on all.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote treatises on astronomy, geography, military institutions, and penal law.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，贈刑部尚書，謚端毅。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing he was posthumously made minister of justice with the posthumous title Duanyi.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Longqing reign he was posthumously made minister of justice with the posthumous title Duanyi (Upright and Resolute).

sentences.zh: 子愨，南京工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Zi Que was right vice minister of works at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zi Que served as right vice minister of works at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 歷官亦有聲。

translations.literal: In successive offices he too had a reputation.
translations.idiomatic: In successive offices he too earned a fine reputation.

sentences.zh: 汪元錫，字天啟，婺源人。

translations.literal: Wang Yuanxi, style name Tianqi, was a native of Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yuanxi, styled Tianqi, was from Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 正德六年進士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhengde he passed the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a metropolitan graduate in the sixth year of the Zhengde reign (1511).

sentences.zh: 授兵科給事中。

translations.literal: He was appointed a supervising secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a supervising secretary in the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三遷都給事中。

translations.literal: After three promotions he became chief supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: After three promotions he became chief supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 陜西鎮守中官廖鸞族子鎧，冒功為錦衣千戶，隨鸞於陜。

translations.literal: Liao Luan, the eunuch guarding Shaanxi, had a clansman Kai who falsely claimed merit and became a chiliarch of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, following Luan in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Luan, the eunuch guarding Shaanxi, had a clansman Kai who falsely claimed merit to become a chiliarch of the Embroidered Uniform Guard and accompanied Luan in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 元錫爭之，言鎧父鵬已亂中州，勿使鎧復亂陜右。

translations.literal: Yuanxi protested, saying Kai's father Peng had already thrown the central provinces into disorder and Kai must not be allowed to throw the western Shaanxi region into disorder again.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxi protested, saying Kai's father Peng had already thrown the central provinces into disorder and Kai must not be allowed to do the same in western Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 乞征還鸞，置鎧父子於理。

translations.literal: He begged that Luan be recalled and father and son Kai be brought to justice.
translations.idiomatic: He begged that Luan be recalled and that father and son Kai be brought to justice.

sentences.zh: 偏頭關之捷，錄功太濫，偕同官言太監張忠、總兵官劉暉等不宜賞。

translations.literal: For the victory at Piankou Pass rewards were recorded too lavishly; together with colleagues he said the eunuch Zhang Zhong, regional commander Liu Hui, and others ought not be rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: After the victory at Piankou Pass rewards were distributed too lavishly; together with colleagues he argued that the eunuch Zhang Zhong, regional commander Liu Hui, and others ought not be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 湖廣鎮守太監杜甫請巡歷所部，帝許之，元錫等據祖制力爭。

translations.literal: Du Fu, the eunuch guarding Huguang, requested to tour his jurisdiction; the emperor assented; Yuanxi and others forcefully contended on the basis of ancestral institutions.
translations.idiomatic: Du Fu, the eunuch guarding Huguang, requested to tour his jurisdiction; when the emperor assented, Yuanxi and others forcefully protested on the basis of ancestral institutions.

sentences.zh: 帝幸昌平、宣府、大同，元錫偕同官邢寰累疏諫；

translations.literal: When the emperor visited Changping, Xuanfu, and Datong, Yuanxi together with his colleague Xing Huan repeatedly memorialized in remonstrance;
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited Changping, Xuanfu, and Datong, Yuanxi and his colleague Xing Huan repeatedly memorialized in remonstrance;

sentences.zh: 復言宣府守將朱振等皆扈從西巡，寇乘虛入塞，何以禦之？

translations.literal: again saying the defending generals of Xuanfu such as Zhu Zhen all accompanied the western tour, so if bandits seized the opportunity to enter the passes, how could they be resisted?
translations.idiomatic: he added that the defending generals of Xuanfu such as Zhu Zhen had all joined the western tour, so if raiders seized the opportunity to enter the passes, how could they be resisted?

sentences.zh: 已，聞帝將選禁軍親征四海治部寇，復極陳不可。

translations.literal: Later, hearing the emperor would select palace troops to campaign in person against the Sihai Zhibu bandits, he again forcefully stated it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Later, learning that the emperor planned to select palace troops to campaign in person against the Sihai Zhibu bandits, he again forcefully argued that this must not be done.

sentences.zh: 安遠侯柳文鎮湖廣，奏攜參隨七十余人，元錫乞寢所奏。

translations.literal: Marquis of Anyuan Liu Wen guarded Huguang and memorialized bringing more than seventy attendants; Yuanxi begged that the memorial be shelved.
translations.idiomatic: When Marquis of Anyuan Liu Wen, guarding Huguang, memorialized that he would bring more than seventy attendants, Yuanxi begged that the memorial be shelved.

sentences.zh: 車駕還京，以應州之捷大賚文武群臣。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned to the capital, the victory at Yingzhou was used to bestow great rewards on civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage returned to the capital, the victory at Yingzhou was used to bestow lavish rewards on civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 元錫等言：「是役殺邊民無算，六軍多傷。

translations.literal: Yuanxi and others said: "In this campaign border people were killed beyond counting and the six armies suffered many wounds.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxi and others said: "In this campaign countless border people were killed and the six armies suffered heavy casualties.

sentences.zh: 今君臣欣喜交賀，而軍民系賊庭，南向號哭，臣等何忍受賜？

translations.literal: Now ruler and ministers rejoice and congratulate one another, while soldiers and people are bound in the rebel court, weeping southward—how can we bear to accept rewards?"
translations.idiomatic: Now ruler and ministers rejoice and congratulate one another, while soldiers and civilians remain captive in the rebel camp, weeping toward the south—how can we bear to accept rewards?"

sentences.zh: 」中旨以納粟都指揮馬昊守備儀真，復遣內官分守潼關、山海關，駕又幸大喜峰口，欲招三衛花當、把兒孫，元錫等皆抗章諫。

translations.literal: " By inner rescript the grain-paying regional commander Ma Hao was made to guard Yizhen; inner eunuchs were again sent to guard Tong Pass and Shanhai Pass separately; the carriage again visited Daxingfeng Pass, wishing to summon Huadang and Ba'ersun of the three guards; Yuanxi and others all submitted forceful remonstrances.
translations.idiomatic: " By inner rescript the grain-paying regional commander Ma Hao was assigned to guard Yizhen; inner eunuchs were again dispatched to guard Tong Pass and Shanhai Pass; the emperor again visited Daxingfeng Pass, intending to summon Huadang and Ba'ersun of the three guards—and Yuanxi and others all submitted forceful remonstrances.

sentences.zh: 帝欲南幸，舒芬、黃鞏切諫得罪，給事御史遂不敢爭。

translations.literal: When the emperor wished to travel south, Shu Fen and Huang Gong remonstrated sharply and were punished; supervising secretaries and censors then dared not contend.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor wished to travel south, Shu Fen and Huang Gong remonstrated sharply and were punished, after which supervising secretaries and censors dared not protest.

sentences.zh: 及帝將親征宸濠，元錫復諫沮。

translations.literal: When the emperor was about to campaign in person against Chen Hao, Yuanxi again remonstrated to dissuade him.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was about to campaign in person against Chen Hao, Yuanxi again remonstrated to dissuade him.

sentences.zh: 宸濠就執，元錫、寰偕六科馳疏請回鑾。

translations.literal: When Chen Hao was captured, Yuanxi and Huan together with the six bureaus hurriedly memorialized requesting return of the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Once Chen Hao was captured, Yuanxi and Huan, together with the six bureaus, hurriedly memorialized requesting that the emperor return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十五年，帝在南京，元錫等復屢申前請，且言：「供億繁費，使牒旁午。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, while the emperor was at Nanjing, Yuanxi and others again repeatedly pressed their earlier requests and said: "Supplies are costly and abundant; messengers' documents come incessantly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, while the emperor was at Nanjing, Yuanxi and others again repeatedly pressed their earlier requests, saying: "Supplies are costly and abundant, and messengers' documents arrive incessantly.

sentences.zh: 奸宄冒官校，少女充離宮。

translations.literal: Evildoers pose as official attendants; young girls fill the detached palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Evildoers pose as official attendants, and young girls fill the detached palaces.

sentences.zh: 陛下不以宗社為重，專事逸遊，豈能長保天下。

translations.literal: Your Majesty does not take the altars of state and grain as weighty but devotes yourself to idle travel—how can you long preserve the realm?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty does not treat the altars of state as paramount but devotes yourself to idle travel—how can you long preserve the realm?

sentences.zh: 」語甚危切。

translations.literal: " The language was very grave and urgent.
translations.idiomatic: " Their language was grave and urgent.

sentences.zh: 中旨以內官晁進、楊保分守蘭州、肅州，元錫等言：「二州逼強寇，不可增官守，累居民。

translations.literal: By inner rescript the inner eunuchs Chao Jin and Yang Bao were sent to guard Lanzhou and Suzhou separately; Yuanxi and others said: "The two prefectures press upon strong bandits; one must not increase official garrisons and burden the people.
translations.idiomatic: By inner rescript the eunuchs Chao Jin and Yang Bao were sent to guard Lanzhou and Suzhou separately; Yuanxi and others said: "These two prefectures border powerful enemies; additional garrisons must not be imposed to burden the people.

sentences.zh: 」群小不悅，矯旨責之。

translations.literal: " The petty faction was displeased and forged an edict to rebuke them.
translations.idiomatic: " The petty faction was displeased and forged an edict to rebuke them.

sentences.zh: 詔改團營西官廳為威武團練營，以江彬、許泰等提督之，別擇地為團營教場。

translations.literal: An edict changed the western official hall of the Tuan barracks to the Weiwu Tuanlian Camp, with Jiang Bin, Xu Tai, and others supervising it, and another site was chosen for the Tuan barracks drill ground.
translations.idiomatic: An edict changed the western official hall of the Tuan barracks to the Weiwu Tuanlian Camp under the supervision of Jiang Bin, Xu Tai, and others, and another site was chosen for the Tuan barracks drill ground.

sentences.zh: 元錫言：「拓地則擾居民，興工則費財力，以朝廷自將之軍而彬等概加提督，則僭名分。

translations.literal: Yuanxi said: "Expanding land will disturb residents; launching works will waste wealth and labor; to have troops the court commands in person all placed under Bin's supervision is to usurp ranks and titles.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxi said: "Expanding the grounds will disturb residents; launching construction will waste wealth and labor; placing troops the court commands in person entirely under Bin's supervision usurps proper ranks and titles.

sentences.zh: 」不從。

translations.literal: " His plea was not followed.
translations.idiomatic: " His plea was not accepted.

sentences.zh: 會帝崩，事已。

translations.literal: When the emperor died, the matter ended.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor died, the matter came to an end.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，疏言：「都督郤永以附江彬下獄，宜釋而用之。

translations.literal: When the Shizong Emperor ascended the throne, he memorialized: "Regional commander Xi Yong was imprisoned for siding with Jiang Bin and should be released and employed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shizong Emperor ascended the throne, he memorialized: "Regional commander Xi Yong was imprisoned for siding with Jiang Bin and should be released and employed.

sentences.zh: 錦衣都指揮郭鰲等十人皆彬黨，宜下獄治。

translations.literal: Ten men including Guo Ao, regional commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, are all Bin's faction and should be imprisoned and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Ten men including Guo Ao, regional commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, are all Jiang Bin's faction and should be imprisoned and punished.

sentences.zh: 」鹹報可。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved all of this.

sentences.zh: 張銑、許泰系獄，帝忽宥其死。

translations.literal: Zhang Xian and Xu Tai were imprisoned; the emperor suddenly pardoned them from death.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xian and Xu Tai were imprisoned, but the emperor suddenly pardoned them from death.

sentences.zh: 元錫爭，不聽。

translations.literal: Yuanxi protested; the emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxi protested, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 屢遷至太仆卿。

translations.literal: After repeated promotions he reached minister of the imperial stud.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated promotions he reached minister of the imperial stud.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖六年，帝以李福達獄下三法司於理。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiajing the emperor sent the three judicial offices to try the Li Fuda case.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Jiajing the emperor sent the three judicial offices to try the Li Fuda case.

sentences.zh: 元錫不能平，有後言，聞於張璁，並下獄奪職。

translations.literal: Yuanxi could not accept this calmly and made remarks afterward; Zhang Cong heard of them, and Yuanxi was imprisoned and stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxi could not accept this calmly and made remarks afterward; when Zhang Cong heard of them, Yuanxi was imprisoned and stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 後用薦起故官。

translations.literal: Later, on recommendation, he was restored to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: Later, on recommendation, he was restored to his former office.

sentences.zh: 歷戶部左、右侍郎，致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He served successively as left and right vice minister of revenue, retired, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as left and right vice minister of revenue, retired, and died.

sentences.zh: 邢寰，黃梅人。

translations.literal: Xing Huan was a native of Huangmei.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Huan was from Huangmei.

sentences.zh: 正德三年進士。

translations.literal: He was a metropolitan graduate in the third year of Zhengde.
translations.idiomatic: He became a metropolitan graduate in the third year of the Zhengde reign (1508).

sentences.zh: 數言事，有直聲。

translations.literal: He repeatedly spoke on affairs and had a reputation for forthrightness.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly spoke out on public affairs and earned a reputation for forthrightness.

sentences.zh: 寇天敘，字子惇，榆次人。

translations.literal: Kou Tianxu, style name Zidun, was a native of Yuci.
translations.idiomatic: Kou Tianxu, styled Zidun, was from Yuci.

sentences.zh: 由鄉舉入太學。

translations.literal: Through provincial recommendation he entered the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Through provincial recommendation he entered the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 與崔銑、呂柟善。

translations.literal: He was on good terms with Cui Shuan and Lu Nan.
translations.idiomatic: He was on good terms with Cui Shuan and Lu Nan.

sentences.zh: 登正德三年進士，除南京大理評事，進寺副。

translations.literal: He passed the metropolitan examination in the third year of Zhengde, was appointed an evaluator at the Nanjing Court of Judicial Review, and advanced to vice director of the court.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the third year of Zhengde, was appointed an evaluator at the Nanjing Court of Judicial Review, and was promoted to vice director of the court.

sentences.zh: 累遷應天府丞。

translations.literal: He was promoted through offices to vice prefect of Yingtian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to vice prefect of Yingtian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 武宗駐南京，從官衛士十余萬，日費金萬計，近幸求索倍之。

translations.literal: When the Wuzong Emperor resided at Nanjing, attendant officials and guards numbered more than a hundred thousand; daily expenses ran to tens of thousands in gold, and favorites' demands doubled that.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wuzong Emperor resided at Nanjing, attendant officials and guards numbered more than a hundred thousand; daily expenses ran to tens of thousands in gold, and the demands of favorites doubled that.

sentences.zh: 尹齊宗道憂懼卒，天敘攝其事，日青衣皂帽坐堂上。

translations.literal: Yin Qizong died of worry and fear; Tianxu took charge of affairs, daily sitting in court in blue robes and black caps.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Qizong died of worry and fear; Tianxu took charge of affairs, daily sitting in court dressed in plain blue robes and black caps.

sentences.zh: 江彬使者至，好語之曰：「民窮官帑乏，無可結歡，丞專待譴耳。

translations.literal: When Jiang Bin's envoys arrived, he spoke kindly to them, saying: "The people are impoverished and the official treasury is empty; there is nothing with which to win favor—the vice prefect can only await punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiang Bin's envoys arrived, he spoke to them kindly: "The people are impoverished and the official treasury is empty; there is nothing with which to win favor—the vice prefect can only await punishment.

sentences.zh: 」彬使累至皆然，彬亦止。

translations.literal: " Bin's envoys came repeatedly and received the same answer; Bin also desisted.
translations.idiomatic: " Bin's envoys came repeatedly and received the same answer, and Bin eventually desisted.

sentences.zh: 他權幸有求，則曰：「俟若奏即予。

translations.literal: When other powerful favorites made requests, he would say: "Wait until you memorialize and it will be granted at once.
translations.idiomatic: When other powerful favorites made requests, he would say: "Wait until you memorialize and it will be granted at once.

sentences.zh: 」禁軍攫民物，天敘與兵部尚書喬宇選拳勇者與搏戲。

translations.literal: " Palace troops seized civilians' goods; Tianxu and Minister of War Qiao Yu selected men skilled in boxing to wrestle with them.
translations.idiomatic: " When palace troops seized civilians' goods, Tianxu and Minister of War Qiao Yu selected men skilled in boxing to wrestle with them.

sentences.zh: 禁軍卒受傷，慚且畏，不敢橫。

translations.literal: Palace soldiers were injured, ashamed and fearful, and dared not act arrogantly.
translations.idiomatic: Palace soldiers were injured, ashamed and fearful, and dared not act arrogantly.

sentences.zh: 其隨事禁制多類此。

translations.literal: His prohibitions on various matters were mostly of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: His prohibitions on various matters were mostly of this kind.

sentences.zh: 駕駐九月，南京不大困者，天敘與宇力也。

translations.literal: During the nine months the imperial carriage resided there, that Nanjing was not greatly distressed was due to the efforts of Tianxu and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: During the nine months the emperor resided there, the fact that Nanjing was not greatly distressed was due to the efforts of Tianxu and Yu.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三年，以右僉都御史巡撫宣府。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiajing he was made right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiajing he was appointed right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 未行，改鄖陽。

translations.literal: Before he departed he was transferred to Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: Before he departed he was transferred to Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 甫二月，又改甘肅。

translations.literal: After only two months he was again transferred to Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: After only two months he was again transferred to Gansu.

sentences.zh: 回賊犯山丹，督將士擒其長脫脫木兒。

translations.literal: Hui bandits invaded Shandan; he supervised officers and soldiers in capturing their leader Tuotuomu'er.
translations.idiomatic: When Hui bandits invaded Shandan, he supervised officers and soldiers in capturing their leader Tuotuomu'er.

sentences.zh: 西域貢獅子、犀牛、西狗，天敘請卻之，不聽。

translations.literal: The Western Regions presented lions, rhinoceroses, and western dogs; Tianxu requested that these be declined; the emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: When the Western Regions presented lions, rhinoceroses, and western dogs, Tianxu requested that these be declined, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 進右副都御史，巡撫陜西。

translations.literal: He was advanced to right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 寇入固原，擊敗之，斬首百余。

translations.literal: Bandits entered Guyuan; he defeated them and took more than a hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits entered Guyuan, he defeated them and took more than a hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 又討平大盜王居等，累賜銀幣。

translations.literal: He also campaigned and pacified the great bandit Wang Ju and others, and was repeatedly rewarded with silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: He also campaigned and pacified the great bandit Wang Ju and others, and was repeatedly rewarded with silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 織造太監至，有司議奏罷之。

translations.literal: When the weaving eunuch arrived, local officials discussed memorializing to abolish the post.
translations.idiomatic: When the weaving eunuch arrived, local officials discussed memorializing to abolish the post.

sentences.zh: 天敘曰：「甫至遽請罷，即不罷，焰且益張。

translations.literal: Tianxu said: "If one has just arrived and immediately requests abolition, even if it is not abolished, his arrogance will only grow greater.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxu said: "If we request abolition as soon as he arrives, even should the post not be abolished, his arrogance will only grow.

sentences.zh: 」會歲祲，乃請蠲租稅，發粟振饑民；

translations.literal: " It happened to be a year of crop failure; he then requested remission of rents and taxes and distribution of grain to relieve the hungry;
translations.idiomatic: " It happened to be a year of crop failure; he then requested remission of rents and taxes and distribution of grain to relieve the hungry;

sentences.zh: 因言織造非儉歲所宜設，帝立召還。

translations.literal: and because he said weaving establishments were not appropriate in frugal years, the emperor immediately recalled the eunuch.
translations.idiomatic: adding that weaving establishments were inappropriate in years of scarcity, whereupon the emperor immediately recalled the eunuch.

sentences.zh: 歷兵部右侍郎，卒。

translations.literal: He served as right vice minister of war and died.
translations.idiomatic: He served as right vice minister of war and died.

sentences.zh: 家貧，喪事不具。

translations.literal: His family was poor and funeral arrangements were incomplete.
translations.idiomatic: His family was poor and could not afford a proper funeral.

sentences.zh: 天敘在太學時，嘗聞父疾，馳六晝夜抵家，父疾亦廖。

translations.literal: When Tianxu was in the Imperial Academy, he once heard his father was ill, galloped home in six days and nights, and his father's illness also recovered.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxu was in the Imperial Academy, he once heard his father was ill, galloped home in six days and nights, and his father's illness likewise abated.

sentences.zh: 唐胄，字平侯，瓊山人。

translations.literal: Tang Zhou, style name Pinghou, was a native of Qiongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Zhou, styled Pinghou, was from Qiongshan.

sentences.zh: 弘治十五年進士。

translations.literal: He was a metropolitan graduate in the fifteenth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He became a metropolitan graduate in the fifteenth year of the Hongzhi reign (1502).

sentences.zh: 授戶部主事。

translations.literal: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 以憂歸。

translations.literal: He returned home for mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home for mourning.

sentences.zh: 劉瑾斥諸服除久不赴官者，坐奪職。

translations.literal: Liu Jin dismissed all who, after mourning ended, had long failed to take up office; Zhou was stripped of office on this charge.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jin dismissed all who, after mourning ended, had long failed to take up office; Zhou was stripped of office on this charge.

sentences.zh: 瑾誅，召用，以母老不出。

translations.literal: When Jin was executed, Zhou was summoned to office but did not emerge because his mother was old.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin was executed, Zhou was summoned to office but declined because his mother was elderly.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初，起故官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiajing he was restored to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiajing reign he was restored to his former office.

sentences.zh: 疏諫內官織造，請為宋死節臣趙與珞追謚立祠。

translations.literal: He memorialized remonstrating against inner eunuch weaving establishments and requested that a posthumous title and temple be granted to Zhao Yuluo, a Song minister who died for principle.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized against inner eunuch weaving establishments and requested a posthumous title and temple for Zhao Yuluo, a Song minister who died for principle.

sentences.zh: 進員外郎，遷廣西提學僉事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice director and transferred to education vice commissioner of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director and transferred to education vice commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 令土官及瑤、蠻悉遣子入學。

translations.literal: He ordered native officials and Yao and Man peoples all to send sons to study.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered native officials and Yao and Man peoples alike to send their sons to school.

sentences.zh: 擢金騰副使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice commissioner of Jinteng.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice commissioner of Jinteng.

sentences.zh: 土酋莽信虐，計擒之。

translations.literal: The native chieftain Mang Xin was cruel; Zhou devised a plan and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: The native chieftain Mang Xin was cruel; Zhou devised a plan and captured him.

sentences.zh: 木邦、孟養構兵，胄遣使宣諭，木邦遂獻地。

translations.literal: Mubang and Mengyang raised troops against each other; Zhou sent envoys to proclaim and instruct, and Mubang thereupon ceded territory.
translations.idiomatic: When Mubang and Mengyang went to war, Zhou sent envoys to proclaim the court's will, and Mubang thereupon ceded territory.

sentences.zh: 屢遷廣西左布政使。

translations.literal: After repeated promotions he became left administration commissioner of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated promotions he became left administration commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 官軍討古田賊，久無功，胄遣使撫之其魁曰：「是前唐使君令吾子入學者。

translations.literal: Government troops campaigned against the Gutian bandits for long without success; Zhou sent envoys to pacify them, and the ringleader said: "This is the former Tang commissioner who had my son enter school.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops had campaigned against the Gutian bandits for long without success; Zhou sent envoys to pacify them, and the ringleader said: "This is the former Tang commissioner who had my son enter school.

sentences.zh: 」即解甲。

translations.literal: " He thereupon laid down arms.
translations.idiomatic: " He thereupon laid down arms.

sentences.zh: 擢右副都御史，巡撫南、贛，移山東。

translations.literal: He was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief, grand coordinator of Nan and Gan, and transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief, served as grand coordinator of Nan and Gan, and was transferred to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 遷南京戶部右侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to right vice minister of revenue at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to right vice minister of revenue at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 十五年改北部，進左侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to the northern ministry and advanced to left vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to the northern ministry and promoted to left vice minister.

sentences.zh: 帝以安南久不貢，將致討，郭勛復贊之。

translations.literal: Because Annam had long failed to offer tribute, the emperor was about to launch a punitive campaign; Guo Xun again endorsed it.
translations.idiomatic: Because Annam had long failed to offer tribute, the emperor planned a punitive campaign, which Guo Xun again endorsed.

sentences.zh: 詔遣錦衣官問狀，中外嚴兵待發。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched an Embroidered Uniform Guard official to inquire into conditions; within and without the court troops were mustered awaiting deployment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dispatched an Embroidered Uniform Guard official to inquire into conditions, and troops were mustered throughout the realm awaiting deployment.

sentences.zh: 胄上疏諫曰：

translations.literal: Zhou submitted a memorial remonstrating, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Zhou submitted a memorial remonstrating:

sentences.zh: 今日之事，若欲其修貢而已，兵不必用，官亦無容遣。

translations.literal: In today's affair, if one only wishes them to resume tribute, troops need not be used and officials need not be sent.
translations.idiomatic: In the present affair, if we only wish them to resume tribute, troops need not be used and officials need not be sent.

sentences.zh: 若欲討之，則有不可者七，請一一陳之：

translations.literal: If one wishes to punish them, there are seven reasons why this cannot be done; I beg to set them forth one by one:
translations.idiomatic: If we wish to punish them, there are seven reasons why this cannot be done; I beg to set them forth one by one:

sentences.zh: 古帝王不以中國之治治蠻夷，故安南不征，著在《祖訓》。

translations.literal: Ancient emperors and kings did not govern barbarians with the governance of China; therefore Annam was not to be attacked—this is recorded in the Ancestral Instructions.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient emperors did not govern barbarians with the methods used to govern China; therefore Annam was not to be attacked—this is recorded in the Ancestral Instructions.

sentences.zh: 一也。

translations.literal: This is the first reason.
translations.idiomatic: This is the first reason.

sentences.zh: 太宗既滅黎季筼，求陳氏後不得，始郡縣之。

translations.literal: After the Taizong Emperor destroyed Li Jilong, he sought descendants of the Chen house but found none and only then made it into commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: After the Taizong Emperor destroyed Li Jilong, he sought descendants of the Chen house but found none and only then made Annam into commanderies and counties.

sentences.zh: 後兵連不解，仁廟每以為恨。

translations.literal: Later warfare continued without end; the Renzong Emperor always regretted this.
translations.idiomatic: Later warfare continued without end, and the Renzong Emperor always regretted it.

sentences.zh: 章皇帝成先誌，棄而不守，今日當率循。

translations.literal: The Zhang Emperor fulfilled the prior will and abandoned the territory without holding it; today we should follow and adhere to this.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhang Emperor fulfilled his predecessor's will by abandoning the territory; today we should follow that precedent.

sentences.zh: 二也。

translations.literal: This is the second reason.
translations.idiomatic: This is the second reason.

sentences.zh: 外夷分爭，中國之福。

translations.literal: When outer barbarians divide and contend, it is China's good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: When outer barbarians divide and contend among themselves, it is China's good fortune.

sentences.zh: 安南自五代至元，更曲、劉、紹、吳、丁、黎、李、陳八姓，叠興叠廢，而嶺南外警遂稀。

translations.literal: From the Five Dynasties through the Yuan, Annam changed among eight surnames—Qu, Liu, Shao, Wu, Ding, Li, Li, and Chen—rising and falling in succession, and outer alarms south of the ranges thus grew rare.
translations.idiomatic: From the Five Dynasties through the Yuan, Annam changed among eight ruling houses—Qu, Liu, Shao, Wu, Ding, Li, Li, and Chen—rising and falling in succession, and external alarms south of the ranges thus grew rare.

sentences.zh: 今紛爭，正不當問，奈何殃赤子以威小醜，割心腹以補四肢，無益有害。

translations.literal: Now they are in strife—this is precisely when we ought not intervene; why harm innocent children to overawe petty villains, cutting the heart and belly to patch the four limbs—without benefit and with harm?
translations.idiomatic: Now they are in strife—this is precisely when we ought not intervene; why harm innocent people to overawe petty villains, cutting the heartland to patch the limbs—without benefit and with harm?

sentences.zh: 三也。

translations.literal: This is the third reason.
translations.idiomatic: This is the third reason.

sentences.zh: 若謂中國近境，宜乘亂取之。

translations.literal: If one says it is China's near border and one ought to seize it amid disorder,
translations.idiomatic: If one says it is China's near border and we ought to seize it amid disorder,

sentences.zh: 臣考馬援南征，深歷浪泊，士卒死亡幾半，所立銅柱為漢極界，乃近在今思明府耳。

translations.literal: your servant examines Ma Yuan's southern campaign: he deeply traversed Langbo; soldiers died to nearly half; the bronze pillar he erected as Han's utmost border lies close to today's Siming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: I would point out that in Ma Yuan's southern campaign he deeply penetrated Langbo, soldiers died to nearly half their number, and the bronze pillar he erected as Han's utmost border lies close to today's Siming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 先朝雖嘗平之，然屢服屢叛，中國士馬物故者以數十萬計，竭二十余年之財力，僅得數十郡縣之虛名而止。

translations.literal: The prior dynasty though it once pacified the region, yet they repeatedly submitted and repeatedly rebelled; Chinese soldiers and horses who perished numbered in the hundreds of thousands; more than twenty years of wealth and labor were exhausted, and only the empty name of several dozen commanderies and counties was gained.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty once pacified the region, yet they repeatedly submitted and rebelled; Chinese soldiers and horses who perished numbered in the hundreds of thousands; more than twenty years of wealth and labor were exhausted, gaining only the empty name of several dozen commanderies and counties.

sentences.zh: 況又有征之不克，如宋太宗、神宗，元憲宗、世祖朝故事乎？

translations.literal: Moreover there are precedents of campaigns that did not succeed, such as under Song Taizong and Shenzong and under Yuan Xianzong and Shizu?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover there are precedents of campaigns that did not succeed, as under Song Taizong and Shenzong and under Yuan Xianzong and Shizu?

sentences.zh: 此可為殷鑒。

translations.literal: These can serve as stern warnings.
translations.idiomatic: These should serve as stern warnings.

sentences.zh: 四也。

translations.literal: This is the fourth reason.
translations.idiomatic: This is the fourth reason.

sentences.zh: 外邦入貢，乃彼之利。

translations.literal: When foreign states enter tribute, it is their benefit.
translations.idiomatic: When foreign states offer tribute, it is to their own benefit.

sentences.zh: 一則奉正朔以威其鄰，一則通貿易以足其國。

translations.literal: On one hand to accept the reign calendar to overawe their neighbors; on one hand to open trade to enrich their state.
translations.idiomatic: On one hand they accept the reign calendar to overawe their neighbors; on the other they open trade to enrich their state.

sentences.zh: 故今雖兵亂，尚累累奉表箋、具方物，款關求入，守臣以姓名不符卻之。

translations.literal: Therefore though there is warfare now, they have repeatedly submitted memorials and prepared local products, knocking at the passes seeking entry, yet border officials rejected them because names did not match.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, though warfare rages now, they have repeatedly submitted memorials and tribute goods, knocking at the passes to seek entry, yet border officials turned them away because the names did not match.

sentences.zh: 是彼欲貢不得，非抗不貢也。

translations.literal: This means they wished to tribute but could not—it is not that they resisted and refused tribute.
translations.idiomatic: This means they wished to offer tribute but were unable to—it is not that they resisted and refused tribute.

sentences.zh: 以此責之，詞不順。

translations.literal: To blame them on this account—the argument does not accord.
translations.idiomatic: To blame them on this account is an argument that does not hold.

sentences.zh: 五也。

translations.literal: This is the fifth reason.
translations.idiomatic: This is the fifth reason.

sentences.zh: 興師則需餉。

translations.literal: To raise troops requires supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Raising troops requires supplies.

sentences.zh: 今四川有采木之役，貴州有凱口之師，而兩廣積儲數十萬，率耗於田州岑猛之役。

translations.literal: Now Sichuan has timber-cutting corvée, Guizhou has the Kaikou campaign, and the accumulated stores of the two Guang provinces, numbering several hundred thousand, were mostly consumed in the campaign against Cen Meng of Tianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Now Sichuan has timber-cutting corvée, Guizhou has the Kaikou campaign, and the accumulated stores of the two Guang provinces—numbering several hundred thousand—were mostly consumed in the campaign against Cen Meng of Tianzhou.

sentences.zh: 又大工頻興，所在軍儲悉輸將作，興師數十萬，何以給之？

translations.literal: Moreover major construction projects arise frequently; military stores everywhere are all sent to the Directorate of Works. To raise troops numbering in the hundreds of thousands—how are they to be supplied?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, major construction projects arise frequently, and military stores everywhere are sent to the Directorate of Works. To raise an army numbering in the hundreds of thousands—how can it be supplied?

sentences.zh: 六也。

translations.literal: This is the sixth reason.
translations.idiomatic: This is the sixth reason.

sentences.zh: 然臣所憂，又不止此。

translations.literal: Yet what your servant fears is not limited to this.
translations.idiomatic: Yet what I fear is not limited to this.

sentences.zh: 唐之衰也，自明皇南詔之役始。

translations.literal: The Tang dynasty's decline began with Emperor Ming's campaign against Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang dynasty's decline began with Emperor Ming's campaign against Nanzhao.

sentences.zh: 宋之衰也，自神宗伐遼之役始。

translations.literal: The Song dynasty's decline began with Shenzong's campaign against the Liao.
translations.idiomatic: The Song dynasty's decline began with Shenzong's campaign against the Liao.

sentences.zh: 今北寇日強，據我河套。

translations.literal: Now northern enemies grow stronger daily and occupy our Ordos.
translations.idiomatic: Now northern enemies grow stronger daily and occupy our Ordos.

sentences.zh: 邊卒屢叛，毀我藩籬。

translations.literal: Border troops repeatedly rebel and destroy our defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Border troops repeatedly rebel and destroy our defenses.

sentences.zh: 北顧方殷，更啟南征之議，脫有不測，誰任其咎？

translations.literal: With pressing concerns to the north, to open discussion of a southern campaign—if something unforeseen happens, who will bear the blame?
translations.idiomatic: With pressing concerns to the north, to open discussion of a southern campaign—if something unforeseen happens, who will bear the blame?

sentences.zh: 七也。

translations.literal: This is the seventh reason.
translations.idiomatic: This is the seventh reason.

sentences.zh: 錦衣武人，暗於大體。

translations.literal: Embroidered Uniform Guard military men are ignorant of the larger principles.
translations.idiomatic: Embroidered Uniform Guard military men are ignorant of the larger principles.

sentences.zh: 倘稍枉是非之實，致彼不服，反足損威。

translations.literal: If they slightly distort the truth of right and wrong, causing them not to submit, it would rather suffice to damage our prestige.
translations.idiomatic: If they slightly distort the truth of right and wrong and cause them not to submit, it would only damage our prestige.

sentences.zh: 即令按問得情，伐之不可，不伐不可，進退無據，何以為謀？

translations.literal: Even if investigation establishes the facts, to attack is impossible and not to attack is impossible; advancing and retreating lack footing—how can one formulate policy?
translations.idiomatic: Even if investigation establishes the facts, to attack is impossible and not to attack is impossible; with no footing for advance or retreat, how can one formulate policy?

sentences.zh: 且今嚴兵待發之詔初下，而征求騷擾之害已形，是憂不在外夷，而在邦域中矣。

translations.literal: Moreover, though the edict to muster troops awaiting deployment has only just been issued, the harm of levies and harassment has already appeared—the worry lies not with outer barbarians but within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, though the edict to muster troops for deployment has only just been issued, the harm of levies and harassment has already appeared—the worry lies not with outer barbarians but within the realm.

sentences.zh: 請停遣勘官，罷一切征調，天下幸甚。

translations.literal: I beg that dispatch of investigating officials be halted and all levies be canceled—the realm would be greatly fortunate.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the dispatch of investigating officials be halted and all levies be canceled—the realm would be greatly fortunate.

sentences.zh: 章下兵部，請從其議。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to the Ministry of War, which requested that his proposal be adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was sent to the Ministry of War, which requested that his proposal be adopted.

sentences.zh: 得旨，待勘官還更議。

translations.literal: An edict was received: wait until the investigating officials return, then discuss further.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was received: wait until the investigating officials return, then discuss further.

sentences.zh: 明年四月，帝決計征討。

translations.literal: The following year in the fourth month, the emperor decided on a punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the fourth month, the emperor decided on a punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 侍郎潘珍、兩廣總督潘旦、巡按御史余光相繼諫，皆不納。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Pan Zhen, Guangdong-Guangxi Governor-General Pan Dan, and Censor-in-Chief Yu Guang remonstrated in succession—all were rejected.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Pan Zhen, Guangdong-Guangxi Governor-General Pan Dan, and Censor-in-Chief Yu Guang remonstrated in succession, but all were rejected.

sentences.zh: 後遣毛伯溫往，卒撫降之。

translations.literal: Later Mao Bowen was dispatched; in the end he pacified and accepted their surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Later Mao Bowen was dispatched, and in the end he pacified them and accepted their surrender.

sentences.zh: 郭勛為祖英請配享，胄疏爭。

translations.literal: Guo Xun requested that Zu Ying be granted attendant sacrifice; Zhou submitted a memorial disputing it.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xun requested that Zu Ying be granted attendant sacrifice; Zhou submitted a memorial disputing it.

sentences.zh: 帝欲祀獻皇帝明堂，配上帝，胄力言不可。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to sacrifice to the Xian Emperor in the Bright Hall, paired with the Supreme Lord; Zhou forcefully argued it was impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to sacrifice to the Xian Emperor in the Bright Hall, paired with the Supreme Lord; Zhou forcefully argued that this was impermissible.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，下詔獄拷掠，削籍歸。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly angered, had him sent to the imperial prison for torture, stripped of registry, and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly angered, had him sent to the imperial prison for torture, stripped of his official status, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 遇赦復冠帶，卒。

translations.literal: When an amnesty was granted he regained cap and belt; he died.
translations.idiomatic: When an amnesty was granted he regained his official rank; he died.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，贈右都御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing, he was posthumously granted Right Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Longqing reign, he was posthumously granted Right Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 胄耿介孝友，好學多著述，立朝有執持，為嶺南人士之冠。

translations.literal: Zhou was upright, filial and fraternal, fond of learning with many writings; he had firm principles at court and was foremost among men of the Lingnan region.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou was upright, filial, and fraternal, fond of learning and prolific in writing; he held firm principles at court and was foremost among the scholars of Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 潘珍，字玉卿，婺源人。

translations.literal: Pan Zhen, courtesy name Yuqing, was a native of Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Zhen, courtesy name Yuqing, was a native of Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 弘治十五年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the fifteenth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifteenth year of Hongzhi.

sentences.zh: 正德中，歷官山東僉事，分巡袞州。

translations.literal: During Zhengde he served as Shandong surveillance commissioner, circuit-inspecting Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengde reign he served as Shandong surveillance commissioner, with circuit responsibility for Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊劉七等猝至，有備不敢攻，引去，掠曲阜。

translations.literal: When bandits led by Liu Qi suddenly arrived, finding preparations they dared not attack and withdrew, plundering Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits led by Liu Qi suddenly arrived, finding the district prepared they dared not attack and withdrew, plundering Qufu instead.

sentences.zh: 珍奏徙縣治而城之。

translations.literal: Zhen memorialized to move the county seat and wall it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen memorialized to move the county seat and fortify it with walls.

sentences.zh: 遷福建副使，湖廣左布政使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Fujian vice commissioner and Left Administration Commissioner of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Fujian vice commissioner and then Left Administration Commissioner of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖七年以右副都御史巡撫遼東。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing he became Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Jiajing he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 累遷兵部左侍郎。

translations.literal: He was successively promoted to Left Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was successively promoted to Left Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 時議諫討安南，珍上疏諫曰：「陳暠、莫登庸皆殺逆之賊，黎寧與其父譓不請封入貢亦二十年，揆以大義，皆所當討，何獨徇寧請為左右？

translations.literal: At the time there was discussion of remonstrating against a campaign to punish Annam; Zhen submitted a memorial remonstrating, saying: "Chen Gao and Mo Dengyong are both murderous rebels; Li Ning and his father Hui failed to request investiture or offer tribute for twenty years as well. Weighing by great principle, all ought to be punished—why favor Ning's request alone?"
translations.idiomatic: At the time officials debated remonstrating against a campaign to punish Annam; Zhen submitted a memorial remonstrating: "Chen Gao and Mo Dengyong are both murderous rebels; Li Ning and his father Hui also failed to request investiture or offer tribute for twenty years. Weighing by principle, all ought to be punished—why favor Ning's request alone?"

sentences.zh: 且其地不足郡縣置，叛服無與中國。

translations.literal: Moreover its territory is insufficient to establish as commanderies and counties; submission and rebellion have nothing to do with China.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover its territory is insufficient to establish as commanderies and counties; its submission and rebellion have nothing to do with China.

sentences.zh: 今北敵曰蕃，聯帳萬里，烽警屢聞，顧釋門庭防，遠事瘴蠻，非計之得。

translations.literal: Now northern enemies grow daily; yurts stretch for ten thousand li; alarm beacons are frequently heard—yet we would abandon home defense to attend to distant malarial barbarians; this is not a good plan.
translations.idiomatic: Now northern enemies grow stronger daily; their yurts stretch for ten thousand li and alarm beacons are frequently heard—yet we would abandon home defense to attend to distant malarial barbarians; this is not a sound plan.

sentences.zh: 宜遣大臣有文武才者，聲言進討。

translations.literal: One should dispatch a grand minister with both civil and military talent, proclaiming an advance to punish.
translations.idiomatic: We should dispatch a senior minister with both civil and military talent and proclaim an advance to punish them.

sentences.zh: 檄數登庸罪，赦其脅從，且令黎寧合剿。

translations.literal: Issue a proclamation listing Mo Dengyong's crimes, pardon those coerced to follow, and order Li Ning to join in the attack.
translations.idiomatic: Issue a proclamation listing Mo Dengyong's crimes, pardon those coerced to follow him, and order Li Ning to join in the attack.

sentences.zh: 賊父子不擒則降，何必勞師？

translations.literal: If the rebel father and son are not captured they will surrender—why must we weary the army?
translations.idiomatic: If the rebel father and son are not captured they will surrender—why must we weary the army?

sentences.zh: 」帝責珍撓成命，褫職歸。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Zhen for obstructing the settled decision and stripped him of office, sending him home.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked Zhen for obstructing the settled decision, stripped him of office, and sent him home.

sentences.zh: 尋以恩詔復官，致仕。

translations.literal: Soon through an amnesty edict he was restored to office and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, through an amnesty edict, he was restored to office and then retired.

sentences.zh: 珍廉直有行誼，中外十余薦，皆報寢。

translations.literal: Zhen was incorrupt and upright with moral conduct; more than ten recommendations inside and outside court all went unanswered.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was incorrupt and upright with strong moral conduct; more than ten recommendations from inside and outside court all went unanswered.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈右都御史。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously granted Right Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously granted Right Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 珍族子旦，字希周。

translations.literal: Zhen's clansman Dan, courtesy name Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen's clansman Dan, courtesy name Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 弘治十八年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the eighteenth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the eighteenth year of Hongzhi.

sentences.zh: 知漳州邵武。

translations.literal: He served as magistrate of Zhangzhou and Shaowu.
translations.idiomatic: He served as magistrate of Zhangzhou and Shaowu.

sentences.zh: 三遷浙江左布政使。

translations.literal: After three promotions he became Left Administration Commissioner of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: After three promotions he became Left Administration Commissioner of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 斥羨金不取。

translations.literal: He rejected surplus silver and would not take it.
translations.idiomatic: He rejected surplus silver and refused to take it.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖八年擢右副都御史，撫治鄖陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiajing he was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and charged with pacifying Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Jiajing he was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and charged with pacifying Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 數平巨寇。

translations.literal: He several times pacified major bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He several times pacified major bandits.

sentences.zh: 累遷刑部右侍郎。

translations.literal: He was successively promoted to Right Vice Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was successively promoted to Right Vice Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 十五年冬，以兵部左侍郎提督兩廣軍務。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifteenth year, as Left Vice Minister of War he supervised military affairs in the two Guang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifteenth year, as Left Vice Minister of War he supervised military affairs in the two Guang provinces.

sentences.zh: 詔起復毛伯溫討安南。

translations.literal: An edict recalled Mao Bowen from mourning to campaign against Annam.
translations.idiomatic: An edict recalled Mao Bowen from mourning to campaign against Annam.

sentences.zh: 旦行過其裏，語之曰：「安南非門庭寇。

translations.literal: As Dan passed his village he said to him: "Annam is not a threat at our doorstep.
translations.idiomatic: As Dan passed Bowen's village he said to him: "Annam is not a threat at our doorstep.

sentences.zh: 公宜以終喪辭。

translations.literal: You, sir, ought to decline citing completion of mourning obligations.
translations.idiomatic: You ought to decline the appointment, citing your mourning obligations.

sentences.zh: 往來之間，少緩師期。

translations.literal: In the back and forth, slightly delay the campaign schedule.
translations.idiomatic: In the back and forth, slightly delay the campaign schedule.

sentences.zh: 俟其聞命求款，因撫之，可百全也。

translations.literal: Wait until, hearing the command, they seek terms, then pacify them—it can be entirely safe.
translations.idiomatic: Wait until, hearing the command, they seek terms, then pacify them—it can be entirely safe.

sentences.zh: 」旦抵廣，適安南使至，馳疏言：「莫登庸之篡黎氏，猶黎氏之篡陳氏也。

translations.literal: When Dan reached Guang, an Annam envoy happened to arrive; he sent an urgent memorial saying: "Mo Dengyong's usurpation of the Li house is like the Li house's usurpation of the Chen house.
translations.idiomatic: When Dan reached Guang, an Annam envoy happened to arrive; he sent an urgent memorial saying: "Mo Dengyong's usurpation of the Li house is like the Li house's usurpation of the Chen house.

sentences.zh: 朝廷將興問罪師，登庸即有求貢之使，何嘗不畏天威？

translations.literal: The court was about to raise a punitive army, and Mo Dengyong immediately sent envoys seeking to offer tribute—how has he not feared heavenly majesty?
translations.idiomatic: The court was about to raise a punitive army, and Mo Dengyong immediately sent envoys seeking to offer tribute—has he not feared heavenly majesty?

sentences.zh: 乞容臣等觀變，待彼國自定。

translations.literal: I beg that your servants be allowed to observe changes and wait for their country to settle itself.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that we be allowed to observe developments and wait for their country to settle itself.

sentences.zh: 若登庸奉表獻琛，於中國體足矣，豈必窮兵萬里哉。」

translations.literal: If Mo Dengyong submits a memorial and presents tribute gems, China's dignity would suffice—must we pursue warfare ten thousand li?"
translations.idiomatic: If Mo Dengyong submits a memorial and presents tribute, China's dignity would be satisfied—must we pursue warfare ten thousand li?"

sentences.zh: 章下禮、兵二部。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to the Ministries of Rites and War.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was sent to the Ministries of Rites and War.

sentences.zh: 族父珍適以言得罪，尚書嚴嵩、張瓚絀旦議不用。

translations.literal: His clansman Zhen had just been punished for his words; Ministers Yan Song and Zhang Zan rejected Dan's proposal and did not adopt it.
translations.idiomatic: His clansman Zhen had just been punished for his words; Ministers Yan Song and Zhang Zan rejected Dan's proposal and did not adopt it.

sentences.zh: 會伯溫人都，見旦疏不悅。

translations.literal: When Bowen entered the capital, he saw Dan's memorial and was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: When Bowen entered the capital, he saw Dan's memorial and was displeased.

sentences.zh: 言總督任重，宜擇知兵者。

translations.literal: He said the governor-general's task was weighty and one who knew warfare should be chosen.
translations.idiomatic: He said the governor-general's task was weighty and that someone who knew warfare should be chosen.

sentences.zh: 遂改旦南京兵部，以張經代之。

translations.literal: Dan was then transferred to the Nanjing Ministry of War, and Zhang Jing replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Dan was then transferred to the Nanjing Ministry of War, and Zhang Jing replaced him.

sentences.zh: 未行，引疾乞休，語侵伯溫。

translations.literal: Before departing, he cited illness and requested retirement; his words insulted Bowen.
translations.idiomatic: Before departing, he cited illness and requested retirement; his words insulted Bowen.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，勒致仕。

translations.literal: The emperor was angered and compelled him to retire.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angered and compelled him to retire.

sentences.zh: 將還，吏白例支庫金為道里費。

translations.literal: As he was about to return, a clerk reported that per regulation treasury gold would be disbursed for travel expenses.
translations.idiomatic: As he was about to return, a clerk reported that per regulation treasury funds would be disbursed for travel expenses.

sentences.zh: 旦笑曰：「吾不以妄取為例。

translations.literal: Dan smiled and said: "I do not take wrongful gains as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Dan smiled and said: "I do not take wrongful gains as precedent.

sentences.zh: 」卒，贈工部尚書。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously granted Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously granted Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 旦上書半歲，廣東巡按御史余光亦言：「黎氏魚肉國君，在陳氏為賊子；

translations.literal: Half a year after Dan submitted his memorial, Guangdong Censor-in-Chief Yu Guang also said: "The Li clan oppressed their ruler; toward the Chen house they were unfilial sons;
translations.idiomatic: Half a year after Dan submitted his memorial, Guangdong Censor-in-Chief Yu Guang also said: "The Li clan oppressed their ruler; toward the Chen house they were unfilial sons;

sentences.zh: 抗拒中國，在我朝為亂魁。

translations.literal: they resisted China; in our dynasty they were chief rebels.
translations.idiomatic: they resisted China; in our dynasty they were chief rebels.

sentences.zh: 今失國，或天假手登庸以報之也。

translations.literal: Now having lost the state, perhaps Heaven used Mo Dengyong as its instrument of retribution.
translations.idiomatic: Now that they have lost the state, perhaps Heaven used Mo Dengyong as its instrument of retribution.

sentences.zh: 自宋以來，丁移於李，李奪於陳，陳篡於黎，今黎又轉於莫。

translations.literal: Since the Song, rule passed from Ding to Li, Li was seized by Chen, Chen was usurped by Li, and now Li has passed to Mo.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Song, rule passed from Ding to Li, Li was seized by Chen, Chen was usurped by Li, and now Li has passed to Mo.

sentences.zh: 欲興黎氏，勢必不能。

translations.literal: To wish to restore the Li house is necessarily impossible.
translations.idiomatic: To wish to restore the Li house is necessarily impossible.

sentences.zh: 臣已遣官責其修貢。

translations.literal: Your servant has already dispatched officials ordering them to resume tribute.
translations.idiomatic: I have already dispatched officials ordering them to resume tribute.

sentences.zh: 道里懸遠，往復陳請，必失事機。

translations.literal: The roads are distant; going back and forth with petitions will necessarily miss the opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: The roads are distant; going back and forth with petitions will necessarily miss the opportunity.

sentences.zh: 乞令臣便宜從事。

translations.literal: I beg that your servant be granted discretion to act as circumstances require.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that I be granted discretion to act as circumstances require.

sentences.zh: 」帝以光疏中引五季、六朝事，下之兵部。

translations.literal: Because Guang's memorial cited affairs of the Five Dynasties and Six Dynasties period, the emperor sent it down to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Because Guang's memorial cited affairs of the Five Dynasties and Six Dynasties period, the emperor sent it to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 咎光輕率，奪其俸。

translations.literal: Guang was blamed for rashness and his salary was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Guang was blamed for rashness and his salary was suspended.

sentences.zh: 無何，光進鄉試錄。

translations.literal: Before long Guang submitted the provincial examination records.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Guang submitted the provincial examination records.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書嚴嵩摘其誤，奏之，被逮削籍。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Yan Song found errors in them, memorialized about it, and Guang was arrested and stripped of registry.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Yan Song found errors in them, memorialized about it, and Guang was arrested and stripped of his official status.

sentences.zh: 光，江寧人。

translations.literal: Guang was a native of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Guang was a native of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 李中，字子庸，吉水人，正德九年進士。

translations.literal: Li Zhong, courtesy name Ziyong, was a native of Jishui and became a jinshi in the ninth year of Zhengde.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhong, courtesy name Ziyong, was a native of Jishui and passed the jinshi examination in the ninth year of Zhengde.

sentences.zh: 楊一清為吏部，數召中應言官試，不赴。

translations.literal: When Yang Yiqing was head of the Ministry of Personnel, he repeatedly summoned Zhong to take the censor examination; Zhong did not go.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Yiqing was head of the Ministry of Personnel, he repeatedly summoned Zhong to take the censor examination, but Zhong did not go.

sentences.zh: 及授工部主事，武宗自稱大慶法王，建寺西華門內，用番僧住持，廷臣莫敢言。

translations.literal: When he was appointed director in the Ministry of Works, the Wuzong Emperor styled himself the Great Celebration Dharma King, built a temple inside Xihua Gate, and used Tibetan monks as abbots; court officials dared not speak.
translations.idiomatic: When he was appointed director in the Ministry of Works, the Wuzong Emperor styled himself the Great Celebration Dharma King, built a temple inside Xihua Gate, and installed Tibetan monks as abbots; court officials dared not speak out.

sentences.zh: 中拜官三月即抗疏曰：「曩逆瑾竊權，勢焰薰灼。

translations.literal: Three months after taking office Zhong submitted a bold memorial, saying: "Formerly the traitor Jin usurped power, and his influence scorched all.
translations.idiomatic: Three months after taking office Zhong submitted a bold memorial: "Formerly the traitor Jin usurped power, and his influence scorched all.

sentences.zh: 陛下既悟，誅之無赦，聖武可謂卓絕矣。

translations.literal: Your Majesty once awakened, executed him without mercy—Your sagely martial prowess can be called outstanding.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty once awakened, executed him without mercy—Your sagely martial prowess can be called outstanding.

sentences.zh: 今大權未收，儲位未建，義子未革，紀綱日馳，風俗日壤，小人日進，君子日退，士氣日靡，言路日閉，名器日輕，賄賂日行，禮樂日廢，刑罰日濫，民財日殫，軍政日弊。
