sentences.zh: 提學御史顧潛俾受學於崔銑。

translations.literal: Investigating Education Commissioner Gu Qian had him study under Cui Juan.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Education Commissioner Gu Qian had him study under Cui Juan.

sentences.zh: 登正德九年進士，擢御史，巡鹽河南。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the ninth year of Zhengde, was promoted to censor, and inspected salt in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the ninth year of Zhengde, was promoted to censor, and inspected salt in Henan.

sentences.zh: 錢寧遣人牟鹽利，裳禁不予。

translations.literal: Qian Ning sent men to seize salt profits; Shang forbade and would not grant them.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Ning sent men to seize salt profits; Shang forbade it and would not grant them.

sentences.zh: 巡按山東。

translations.literal: He toured and inspected Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He toured and inspected Shandong.

sentences.zh: 前御史王相忤鎮守中官黎監，被誣下詔獄。

translations.literal: Former Censor Wang Xiang offended Garrison Eunuch Li Jian and was falsely charged and put in the imperial prison.
translations.idiomatic: Former Censor Wang Xiang offended Garrison Eunuch Li Jian and was falsely charged and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 裳抗疏直相，劾監八罪。

translations.literal: Shang submitted a forceful memorial vindicating Xiang and impeached Jian on eight charges.
translations.idiomatic: Shang submitted a forceful memorial vindicating Xiang and impeached Jian on eight charges.

sentences.zh: 帝還自宣府，裳請下罪己詔，新庶政，以結人心。

translations.literal: When the emperor returned from Xuanfu, Shang requested an edict of self-reproach and renewal of ordinary governance to bind people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor returned from Xuanfu, Shang requested an edict of self-reproach and renewal of ordinary governance to bind people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: No reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: No reply was given.

sentences.zh: 山東大水，淹城武、單二城。

translations.literal: Shandong suffered great floods that submerged the cities of Wucheng and Shanxian.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong suffered great floods that submerged the cities of Wucheng and Shanxian.

sentences.zh: 以裳言，命相地改築。

translations.literal: On Shang's recommendation, the emperor ordered sites chosen and rebuilding.
translations.idiomatic: On Shang's recommendation, the emperor ordered new sites chosen and the cities rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 帝幸南都久，裳極陳小人熒惑之害。

translations.literal: The emperor stayed long at the southern capital; Shang vigorously discussed the harm of petty men deluding and bewitching.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor stayed long at the southern capital; Shang vigorously discussed the harm of petty men deluding and bewitching the court.

sentences.zh: 出為鞏昌知府。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Gongchang.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed prefect of Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年舉治行卓異，遷浙江副使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiajing he was recommended for outstanding administrative conduct and was transferred to vice commissioner of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiajing he was recommended for outstanding administrative conduct and was transferred to vice commissioner of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 日啜菜羹，妻操井臼，迎父就養。

translations.literal: Daily he drank vegetable broth; his wife worked the mortar and well, and he welcomed his father to live with him.
translations.idiomatic: Daily he drank vegetable broth; his wife worked the mortar and well, and he welcomed his father to live with him.

sentences.zh: 同列知其貧，制衣一襲為壽，父亦拒不納。

translations.literal: Colleagues knowing his poverty made him a set of clothes as a birthday gift; his father also refused to accept.
translations.idiomatic: Colleagues knowing his poverty made him a set of clothes as a birthday gift; his father also refused to accept.

sentences.zh: 三遷至浙江左布政使，以右副都御史總理河道，數條上方略。

translations.literal: On a third transfer he became Left Administration Commissioner of Zhejiang and as Right Vice Censor-in-Chief overall supervised the waterways, submitting several strategic plans.
translations.idiomatic: On his third transfer he became Left Administration Commissioner of Zhejiang and as Right Vice Censor-in-Chief overall supervised the waterways, submitting several strategic plans.

sentences.zh: 外艱歸，久不起。

translations.literal: Upon mourning for his mother he returned home and long did not resume office.
translations.idiomatic: Upon mourning for his mother he returned home and long did not resume office.

sentences.zh: 帝南巡，謁行在，命以故官總理河道。

translations.literal: When the emperor toured the south he visited the traveling palace and ordered him to overall supervise the waterways in his former office.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor toured the south he visited the traveling palace and ordered him to resume overall supervision of the waterways in his former office.

sentences.zh: 迎章聖太后梓宮，冒暑卒。

translations.literal: Welcoming the coffin of the Empress Dowager Zhangsheng, he died from heat exposure.
translations.idiomatic: While welcoming the coffin of the Empress Dowager Zhangsheng, he died from heat exposure.

sentences.zh: 隆慶中，追贈戶部右侍郎，謚端簡。

translations.literal: During Longqing he was posthumously made Right Vice Minister of Revenue and given the posthumous title Duansian.
translations.idiomatic: During the Longqing reign he was posthumously made Right Vice Minister of Revenue and granted the posthumous title Duansian.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初，按四川。

translations.literal: Early in Jiajing he inspected Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiajing he inspected Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 請罷鎮守中官，不聽。

translations.literal: He requested abolition of garrison eunuchs; the request went unheeded.
translations.idiomatic: He requested abolition of garrison eunuchs, but the request went unheeded.

sentences.zh: 帝親鞫楊言，落其一指。

translations.literal: The emperor personally interrogated Yang Yan and removed one of his fingers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally interrogated Yang Yan and removed one of his fingers.

sentences.zh: 察大呼曰：「臣願以不肖軀易言命，不忍言獨死。

translations.literal: Cha shouted: "Your servant wishes to exchange his unworthy body for Yan's life—I cannot bear that Yan alone should die.
translations.idiomatic: Cha shouted: "I wish to exchange my unworthy body for Yan's life—I cannot bear that Yan alone should die.

sentences.zh: 」帝目攝之，察不為動。

translations.literal: " The emperor glared at him; Cha did not stir.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor glared at him, but Cha did not flinch.

sentences.zh: 退具疏申理，且請下王邦奇於獄，直聲震朝野。

translations.literal: Retiring he submitted a memorial explaining the case and also requested that Wang Bangqi be put in prison; his upright voice shook court and realm.
translations.idiomatic: Retiring, he submitted a memorial explaining the case and also asked that Wang Bangqi be imprisoned; his upright voice shook court and country.

sentences.zh: 巡視京營，與給事中王科極陳武定侯郭勛貪橫狀。

translations.literal: Inspecting the capital garrison, he and Supervising Secretary Wang Ke vigorously described the greedy and overbearing conduct of Marquis Guo Xun of Wuding.
translations.idiomatic: While inspecting the capital garrison, he and Supervising Secretary Wang Ke vigorously described the greedy and overbearing conduct of Marquis Guo Xun of Wuding.

sentences.zh: 擢南京太仆少卿。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Stud at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Stud at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 疏辭，因請召前給事中劉世賢等二十余人。

translations.literal: He memorialized to decline and also requested recall of more than twenty former supervising secretaries such as Liu Shixian.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to decline the post and also asked that more than twenty former supervising secretaries, including Liu Shixian, be recalled.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，責以市恩要名，貶遠方雜職。

translations.literal: The emperor was enraged, rebuked him for currying favor and seeking fame, and demoted him to a distant miscellaneous post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was enraged, rebuked him for currying favor and seeking fame, and demoted him to a distant miscellaneous post.

sentences.zh: 給事中王俊民、鄭一鵬論救，皆奪俸。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretaries Wang Junmin and Zheng Yipeng memorialized to save him; all lost salary.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretaries Wang Junmin and Zheng Yipeng memorialized in his defense; all lost salary.

sentences.zh: 察補海陽教諭。

translations.literal: Cha was reassigned as instructor at Haiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Cha was reassigned as instructor at Haiyang.

sentences.zh: 累遷山西左布政使，入為光祿卿。

translations.literal: He rose by stages to Left Administration Commissioner of Shanxi and entered court as Director of Imperial Entertainment.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Left Administration Commissioner of Shanxi and entered court as Director of Imperial Entertainment.

sentences.zh: 十二年，以僉都御史巡撫南、贛。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was made Vice Censor-in-Chief and governor of southern Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was made Vice Censor-in-Chief and regional governor of southern Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 居二年，乞休，因薦前都御史萬鏜、大理卿董天錫等十四人可用。

translations.literal: After two years he requested retirement and recommended fourteen men such as former Censor-in-Chief Wan Yong and Chief Justice Dong Tianxi as usable.
translations.idiomatic: After two years he requested retirement and recommended fourteen men, including former Censor-in-Chief Wan Yong and Chief Justice Dong Tianxi, as fit for office.

sentences.zh: 吏部請從其言。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel requested that his words be followed.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel asked that his recommendations be followed.

sentences.zh: 帝奪部臣俸，責察徇私妄舉，斥為民。

translations.literal: The emperor stripped the ministry officials of salary, rebuked Cha for favoritism and reckless recommendation, and expelled him as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor stripped the ministry officials of salary, rebuked Cha for favoritism and reckless recommendation, and expelled him as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 察居官廉，既歸，敝衣糲食而已。

translations.literal: Cha in office was incorrupt; after returning home he had only worn clothes and coarse food.
translations.idiomatic: Cha served incorruptibly; after returning home he had only worn clothes and coarse food.

sentences.zh: 孫懋，字德夫，慈溪人。

translations.literal: Sun Mao, courtesy name Defu, was a native of Cixi.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Mao, styled Defu, was from Cixi.

sentences.zh: 正德六年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the sixth year of Zhengde.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the sixth year of Zhengde.

sentences.zh: 授浦城知縣，擢南京吏科給事中。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Pucheng and promoted to supervising secretary of the Ministry of Personnel section at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Pucheng and promoted to supervising secretary in the Ministry of Personnel section at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 御史張經、寧波知府翟唐忤奄人被逮，懋偕同官論救。

translations.literal: Censor Zhang Jing and Ningbo Prefect Zhai Tang offended eunuch men and were arrested; Mao joined colleagues in memorializing to save them.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Jing and Ningbo Prefect Zhai Tang offended eunuch favorites and were arrested; Mao joined colleagues in memorializing to save them.

sentences.zh: 織造太監史宣誣主事王鑾、知縣胡守約，下之詔獄。

translations.literal: Weaving eunuch Shi Xuan falsely charged Chief Clerk Wang Luan and Magistrate Hu Shouyue and had them put in the imperial prison.
translations.idiomatic: Weaving eunuch Shi Xuan falsely charged Chief Clerk Wang Luan and Magistrate Hu Shouyue and had them imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 懋言：「宣妄言禦賜黃棍，聽撻死官吏，脅主簿孫錦死，今又誣守職臣。

translations.literal: Mao said: "Xuan falsely claimed an imperial yellow club and listened while officials were beaten to death, coerced Registrar Sun Jin to death, and now again falsely charges dutiful officials.
translations.idiomatic: Mao said: "Xuan falsely claimed an imperial yellow club and listened while officials were beaten to death, coerced Registrar Sun Jin to death, and now again falsely charges dutiful officials.

sentences.zh: 乞治宣罪，還鑾、守約故任。

translations.literal: I beg that Xuan be punished and Luan and Shouyue be restored to their former posts.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Xuan be punished and Luan and Shouyue be restored to their former posts.

sentences.zh: 」未幾，復偕諸給事言：「臣等屢建白，不擇可否，一概留中。

translations.literal: " Before long he again joined supervising secretaries in saying: "We have repeatedly offered remonstrance, without choosing whether acceptable or not—all are kept at the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long he again joined supervising secretaries in saying: "We have repeatedly offered remonstrance, without choosing whether acceptable or not—all are kept at the palace.

sentences.zh: 萬一奸人陰結黨類，公行阻遏，朝有大事，陛下不聞，大臣不知，禍可勝言！

translations.literal: If by chance wicked men secretly join factions and openly obstruct, and the court has great affairs while Your Majesty does not hear and great ministers do not know—disaster defies description!
translations.idiomatic: If wicked men secretly join factions and openly obstruct, and the court has great affairs while Your Majesty does not hear and great ministers do not know—disaster defies description!

sentences.zh: 」皆不報。

translations.literal: " All went unanswered.
translations.idiomatic: " All went unanswered.

sentences.zh: 已，又劾罷鹽法侍郎薛章，請黜太仆少卿馬陟，留御史徐文華，召還謝遷、韓文、孫交、張原、周廣、高公韶、王思等，罷遊畋射獵，復禦朝常儀，還久留邊兵，汰錦衣冗官，諸疏皆侃侃。

translations.literal: Soon after he again impeached and removed Salt Law Vice Minister Xue Zhang, requested dismissal of Vice Director of Imperial Stud Ma Zhi, retention of Censor Xu Wenhua, recall of Xie Qian, Han Wen, Sun Jiao, Zhang Yuan, Zhou Guang, Gao Gongshao, Wang Si, and others, cessation of hunting and falconry, restoration of regular court audience, return of troops long kept on the frontier, and elimination of redundant Brocade Guard posts—all memorials were forthright.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he again impeached and removed Salt Law Vice Minister Xue Zhang, asked that Vice Director of Imperial Stud Ma Zhi be dismissed, Censor Xu Wenhua be retained, and Xie Qian, Han Wen, Sun Jiao, Zhang Yuan, Zhou Guang, Gao Gongshao, Wang Si, and others be recalled; he also called for an end to hunting and falconry, restoration of regular court audience, return of troops long kept on the frontier, and elimination of redundant Brocade Guard posts—all memorials were forthright.

sentences.zh: 江彬導帝巡幸。

translations.literal: Jiang Bin guided the emperor on tours.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Bin guided the emperor on tours.

sentences.zh: 懋言：「彬梟桀憸邪，挾至尊出居庸，無大臣保護，獨處沙漠將半載。

translations.literal: Mao said: "Bin is fierce, crafty, and treacherous; he took the Son of Heaven out through Juyong Pass with no great ministers to protect him, alone in the desert for nearly half a year.
translations.idiomatic: Mao said: "Bin is fierce, crafty, and treacherous; he took the Son of Heaven out through Juyong Pass with no great ministers to protect him, alone in the desert for nearly half a year.

sentences.zh: 兩宮違養，郊廟不親，四方災異叠見，盜賊蜂起。

translations.literal: The two palaces were deprived of nurture, suburban and temple rites were unattended, strange disasters appeared in succession throughout the realm, and bandits rose like bees.
translations.idiomatic: The two palaces were deprived of nurture, suburban and temple rites went unattended, strange disasters appeared in succession throughout the realm, and bandits rose like bees.

sentences.zh: 留彬一日，為宗社一日憂，乞立置重典。

translations.literal: To keep Bin one day is one day's worry for the altars of state; I beg that heavy punishment be immediately imposed.
translations.idiomatic: To keep Bin one day is one day's worry for the altars of state; I beg that heavy punishment be immediately imposed.

sentences.zh: 」時中外章奏，帝率不省視。

translations.literal: " At the time memorials inside and outside court were generally not examined by the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: " At the time memorials inside and outside court were generally not examined by the emperor.

sentences.zh: 規主闕者，往往得無罪。

translations.literal: Those who remonstrated about the ruler's faults often went unpunished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who remonstrated about the ruler's faults often went unpunished.

sentences.zh: 一觸權幸，禍立至，人皆為懋危。

translations.literal: But to touch powerful favorites brought immediate disaster, and all considered Mao in peril.
translations.idiomatic: But to touch powerful favorites brought immediate disaster, and all considered Mao in peril.

sentences.zh: 而彬方日侍帝娛樂，亦不之見也。

translations.literal: Yet Bin daily attended the emperor's amusements and also did not see it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Bin daily attended the emperor's amusements and paid no heed.

sentences.zh: 請回鑾，諫南幸，懋皆與。

translations.literal: Requests to return the imperial carriage and remonstrance against the southern tour—Mao joined in all.
translations.idiomatic: Requests to return the imperial carriage and remonstrance against the southern tour—Mao joined in all.

sentences.zh: 宸濠反，帝在南都，懋從行。

translations.literal: When Chen Hao rebelled the emperor was at the southern capital; Mao followed on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: When Chen Hao rebelled the emperor was at the southern capital; Mao followed on the journey.

sentences.zh: 請急定平賊功賞，既又數請還京，率同官伏闕，皆不省。

translations.literal: He requested urgent settlement of rewards for suppressing the rebels; afterward he again repeatedly requested return to the capital, leading colleagues to prostrate at the palace gate—all went unheeded.
translations.idiomatic: He requested urgent settlement of rewards for suppressing the rebels; afterward he again repeatedly requested return to the capital, leading colleagues to prostrate at the palace gate—all went unheeded.

sentences.zh: 出為廣東參議，遷副使。

translations.literal: He went out as vice commissioner of Guangdong and was transferred to vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice commissioner of Guangdong and later promoted to vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四年，有錦衣官校偵事廣東，懋與按察使張祐疑其偽，執之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiajing a Brocade Guard attendant was sent to spy in Guangdong; Mao and Surveillance Commissioner Zhang You suspected he was a fake and arrested him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiajing a Brocade Guard attendant was sent to spy in Guangdong; Mao and Surveillance Commissioner Zhang You suspected he was an impostor and arrested him.

sentences.zh: 事聞，逮下詔獄，謫藤縣典史。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported he was arrested and put in the imperial prison and demoted to registrar of Teng County.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported he was arrested, imprisoned, and demoted to registrar of Teng County.

sentences.zh: 屢遷至廣西布政使。

translations.literal: He rose by stages to administration commissioner of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to administration commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 十六年入為應天府尹。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he entered court as prefect of Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he entered court as prefect of Yingtian.

sentences.zh: 坐所進鄉試錄忤旨，致仕，卒。

translations.literal: Because the provincial examination records he submitted offended the intent he retired and died.
translations.idiomatic: Because the provincial examination records he submitted offended the throne, he retired and died.

sentences.zh: 王儀，字克敬，文安人。

translations.literal: Wang Yi, courtesy name Kejing, was a native of Wen'an.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yi, styled Kejing, was from Wen'an.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the second year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 除靈璧知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Lingbi.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Lingbi.

sentences.zh: 以能，調嘉定。

translations.literal: For ability he was transferred to Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: For ability he was transferred to Jiading.

sentences.zh: 七年擢御史，巡按陜西。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to censor and inspected Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was promoted to censor and inspected Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 秦府豪占民產，儀悉奪還民。

translations.literal: The Qin princely establishment's powerful families seized commoners' property; Yi took it all back for the people.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful families of the Qin princely establishment seized commoners' property; Yi took it all back for the people.

sentences.zh: 延綏大饑，朝命陜西布政使胡忠為巡撫，儀論罷之。

translations.literal: Yan-sui suffered great famine; the court ordered Shaanxi Administration Commissioner Hu Zhong as governor; Yi memorialized to dismiss him.
translations.idiomatic: Yan-sui suffered great famine; the court ordered Shaanxi Administration Commissioner Hu Zhong as governor; Yi memorialized to dismiss him.

sentences.zh: 已，巡按河南。

translations.literal: Soon after he inspected Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he inspected Henan.

sentences.zh: 趙府輔國將軍祐椋招亡命殺人劫奪積十余年，莫敢發。

translations.literal: Auxiliary State General You Liang of the Zhao princely establishment recruited fugitives to kill and plunder for more than ten years; no one dared expose it.
translations.idiomatic: Auxiliary State General You Liang of the Zhao princely establishment recruited fugitives to kill and plunder for more than ten years; no one dared expose it.

sentences.zh: 儀偕巡撫吳山奏之，奪爵禁錮。

translations.literal: Yi joined Governor Wu Shan in memorializing; his rank was stripped and he was confined.
translations.idiomatic: Yi joined Governor Wu Shan in memorializing; his rank was stripped and he was confined.

sentences.zh: 會儀出為蘇州知府，甫三月，祐椋潛入都，奏儀捃摭，並訐都御史毛伯溫以私憾入己罪。

translations.literal: As Yi went out as prefect of Suzhou, after only three months You Liang secretly entered the capital and memorialized that Yi had dredged up charges and also denounced Censor-in-Chief Mao Bowen for inserting personal resentment into his own crimes.
translations.idiomatic: As Yi went out as prefect of Suzhou, after only three months You Liang secretly entered the capital and memorialized that Yi had dredged up charges and also denounced Censor-in-Chief Mao Bowen for inserting personal resentment into his own crimes.

sentences.zh: 且言：「臣嘗建醮祈皇嗣，為知府王天民訕笑」，請並按問。

translations.literal: He also said: "Your servant once performed a ritual to pray for an imperial heir and was mocked by Prefect Wang Tianmin"—and requested joint investigation.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Your servant once performed a ritual to pray for an imperial heir and was mocked by Prefect Wang Tianmin"—and requested joint investigation.

sentences.zh: 帝心知祐椋罪，而悅其建醮語。

translations.literal: The emperor knew in his heart that You Liang was guilty, yet was pleased by his ritual language.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor knew in his heart that You Liang was guilty, yet was pleased by his ritual language.

sentences.zh: 為遣使覆按，解儀、伯溫任，下天民獄。

translations.literal: He sent envoys to reinvestigate, relieved Yi and Bowen of office, and put Tianmin in prison.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to reinvestigate, relieved Yi and Bowen of office, and imprisoned Tianmin.

sentences.zh: 使者奏儀不誣，第祐椋罪在赦前，宜輕坐。

translations.literal: The envoys reported that Yi had not falsely charged him, but You Liang's crime fell before an amnesty and ought to be lightly punished.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys reported that Yi had not falsely charged him, but You Liang's crime fell before an amnesty and ought to be lightly punished.

sentences.zh: 帝終憐祐椋愛己，竟復其爵，除儀名，伯溫、山、天民皆得罪。

translations.literal: The emperor ultimately pitied You Liang for loving him and restored his rank, removed Yi's name from office, and Bowen, Shan, and Tianmin all suffered punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ultimately pitied You Liang for loving him and restored his rank, removed Yi from office, and Bowen, Shan, and Tianmin all suffered punishment.

sentences.zh: 終嘉靖世，多以誹謗齋醮獲重禍，由祐椋訐奏始。

translations.literal: Throughout the Jiajing reign many suffered heavy punishment for slandering ritual fasting—beginning from You Liang's denunciation.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the Jiajing reign many suffered heavy punishment for slandering ritual fasting—beginning from You Liang's denunciation.

sentences.zh: 儀去蘇州，士民走闕下乞留，帝不許。

translations.literal: When Yi left Suzhou, scholars and commoners went to the palace gate begging that he be kept; the emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: When Yi left Suzhou, scholars and commoners went to the palace gate begging that he be kept; the emperor did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 既而薦起知撫州。

translations.literal: Soon after he was recommended and raised to prefect of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was recommended and appointed prefect of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 蘇州士民復走闕下乞還儀，至再，不報。

translations.literal: Suzhou scholars and commoners again went to the palace gate begging that Yi be returned—a second time—with no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou scholars and commoners again went to the palace gate begging that Yi be returned—a second time—with no reply.

sentences.zh: 歸訴於巡撫侯位。

translations.literal: Returning they appealed to Governor Hou Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Returning, they appealed to Governor Hou Wei.

sentences.zh: 位以聞，帝乃許之。

translations.literal: Wei reported it and the emperor then permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Wei reported it and the emperor then permitted it.

sentences.zh: 至則嘆曰：「蘇賦當天下什二，而田額淆無可考，何以定賦？

translations.literal: On arrival he sighed: "Suzhou's tax assessment equals one-tenth of the realm, yet land registers are confused beyond reckoning—how can tax be fixed?
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he sighed: "Suzhou's tax assessment equals one-tenth of the realm, yet land registers are confused beyond reckoning—how can tax be fixed?

sentences.zh: 」乃履畝丈之，使縣各為籍。

translations.literal: " He then measured fields by pacing and had each county make its own register.
translations.idiomatic: " He then measured fields by pacing and had each county make its own register.

sentences.zh: 以八事定田賦，以三條核稅課，徭役、雜辦維均。

translations.literal: With eight measures he fixed land tax, with three articles he verified tax levies, and corvée and miscellaneous charges were all equalized.
translations.idiomatic: With eight measures he fixed land tax, with three articles he verified tax levies, and corvée and miscellaneous charges were all equalized.

sentences.zh: 治為知府第一，進浙江副使，飭蘇、松、常、鎮兵備。

translations.literal: His governance ranked first among prefects; he was promoted to vice commissioner of Zhejiang and supervised military affairs in Su, Song, Chang, and Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: His governance ranked first among prefects; he was promoted to vice commissioner of Zhejiang and put in charge of military affairs in Su, Song, Chang, and Zhen.

sentences.zh: 時巡撫歐陽鐸均田賦，儀佐之，以治蘇者推行於旁郡。

translations.literal: At the time Governor Ouyang Duo equalized land tax; Yi assisted him, extending Suzhou methods to neighboring prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Governor Ouyang Duo equalized land tax; Yi assisted him, extending Suzhou methods to neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 坐與操江王學夔討賊敗績，停俸戴罪。

translations.literal: He was punished with suspended salary pending redemption for failing with Wang Xuekui of the River Command in suppressing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He was punished with suspended salary pending redemption for failing with Wang Xuekui of the River Command in suppressing bandits.

sentences.zh: 未幾，殪賊江中，進秩一等，遷山西右參政，分守冀、寧。

translations.literal: Before long the bandits were destroyed on the river; he was advanced one rank and transferred to Right Vice Commissioner of Shanxi, with defense responsibility for Ji and Ning.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the bandits were destroyed on the river; he was advanced one rank and transferred to Right Vice Commissioner of Shanxi, with defense responsibility for Ji and Ning.

sentences.zh: 寇抵清源城，儀洞開城門，寇疑引去。

translations.literal: When raiders reached Qingyuan city Yi opened the city gate wide; the raiders suspected a trap and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When raiders reached Qingyuan city Yi opened the city gate wide; the raiders suspected a trap and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 按行所部，築城郭，積糗糧，榆次、平定間遂皆有城。

translations.literal: Touring his jurisdiction he built city walls and stockpiled grain; between Yuci and Pingding there were then walls everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Touring his jurisdiction he built city walls and stockpiled grain; between Yuci and Pingding there were then walls everywhere.

sentences.zh: 二十一年擢右僉都御史，巡撫宣府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and governor of Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and regional governor of Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 冠入龍門，總兵官郤永等敗之。

translations.literal: Raiders entered Longmen; Regional Commander Chi Yong and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Raiders entered Longmen; Regional Commander Chi Yong and others defeated them.

sentences.zh: 儀進右副都御史。

translations.literal: Yi was advanced to Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was advanced to Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 尋以築邊垣，賚銀幣。

translations.literal: Soon after, for building the frontier wall, he was granted silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, for building the frontier wall, he was granted silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 寇自萬全右衛入，遊騎犯完、唐。

translations.literal: Raiders entered from Wanquan Right Guard and roaming horsemen violated Wan and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Raiders entered from Wanquan Right Guard and roaming horsemen violated Wan and Tang.

sentences.zh: 奪俸二級。

translations.literal: Two ranks of salary were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Two ranks of salary were stripped.

sentences.zh: 考察拾遺，貶一官。

translations.literal: In the performance review for overlooked matters he was demoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the performance review for overlooked matters he was demoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 已，勘上失事罪，貶秩如初。

translations.literal: Soon after, investigating the crime of the defeat above, his demotion was restored as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, investigating the crime of the defeat above, his demotion was restored as before.

sentences.zh: 久之，除肅州兵備副使，協巡撫楊博徙哈密遺種於境外。

translations.literal: After a long time he was appointed vice commissioner for military affairs at Suzhou and, assisting Governor Yang Bo, moved Hami remnant populations beyond the border.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was appointed vice commissioner for military affairs at Suzhou and, assisting Governor Yang Bo, moved Hami remnant populations beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 稍遷右參政，復拜右僉都御史，巡撫甘肅。

translations.literal: He was gradually transferred to vice commissioner and again appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and governor of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He was gradually transferred to vice commissioner and again appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and regional governor of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 未行，俺答犯京師，詔儀馳鎮通州。

translations.literal: Before he departed, Altan invaded the capital region and an edict ordered Yi to hurry to secure Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before he departed, Altan invaded the capital region and an edict ordered Yi to hurry to secure Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 仇鸞部卒掠民貲，捕笞之，枷市門外。

translations.literal: Qiu Luan's camp soldiers plundered commoners' goods; he captured and caned them and put them in the cangue at the market gate.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Luan's camp soldiers plundered commoners' goods; he captured and caned them and put them in the cangue at the market gate.

sentences.zh: 鸞訴於帝，逮訊斥為民，卒。

translations.literal: Luan complained to the emperor; Yi was arrested, interrogated, and expelled as a commoner, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Luan complained to the emperor; Yi was arrested, interrogated, expelled as a commoner, and died.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，子緘訟冤，復官賜恤。

translations.literal: Early in Longqing his son Jian petitioned about the injustice; office was restored and condolence gifts granted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Longqing reign his son Jian petitioned about the injustice; office was restored and condolence gifts granted.

sentences.zh: 緘，官按察使，分巡遼陽，以知兵名。

translations.literal: Jian served as surveillance commissioner, touring Liaodong, and was known for military knowledge.
translations.idiomatic: Jian served as surveillance commissioner touring Liaodong and was known for military knowledge.

sentences.zh: 王學夔，安福人。

translations.literal: Wang Xuekui was a native of Anfu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xuekui was from Anfu.

sentences.zh: 正德時，以吏部主事諫南巡，跪闕下，受杖。

translations.literal: During Zhengde, as a director in the Ministry of Personnel he remonstrated against the southern tour, knelt at the palace gate, and was beaten.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengde reign, as a director in the Ministry of Personnel he remonstrated against the southern tour, knelt at the palace gate, and was beaten.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初，奏請裁戚畹，又申救言官。

translations.literal: Early in Jiajing he memorialized requesting reduction of imperial in-laws and again interceded for remonstrance officials.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiajing reign he memorialized requesting reduction of imperial in-laws and again interceded for remonstrance officials.

sentences.zh: 歷考功、文選郎中，廉謹為時所稱。

translations.literal: He served as director of the Performance Evaluation and Selection bureaus and was praised by contemporaries for integrity and prudence.
translations.idiomatic: He served as director of the Performance Evaluation and Selection bureaus and was praised by contemporaries for integrity and prudence.

sentences.zh: 嘗撫治鄖陽。

translations.literal: He once governed and pacified Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: He once governed and pacified Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 有偽稱皇子者，諸司議用兵。

translations.literal: Someone falsely claimed to be an imperial prince; various offices debated using troops.
translations.idiomatic: Someone falsely claimed to be an imperial prince; various offices debated using troops.

sentences.zh: 學夔曰：「妄豎子耳。

translations.literal: Xuekui said: "A deluded youth only.
translations.idiomatic: Xuekui said: "A deluded youth only.

sentences.zh: 」密捕致之辟。

translations.literal: " He secretly captured him and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: " He secretly captured him and executed him.

sentences.zh: 累遷南京吏、禮、兵三部尚書。

translations.literal: He rose by stages to Minister of Personnel, Rites, and War at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Minister of Personnel, Rites, and War at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 隆慶、萬歷間，存問者再。

translations.literal: During the Longqing and Wanli reigns he was twice sent greetings of inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: During the Longqing and Wanli reigns he was twice sent greetings of inquiry.

sentences.zh: 年九十四卒。

translations.literal: He died at ninety-four.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of ninety-four.

sentences.zh: 贈太子少保。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 曾鈞，字廷和，進賢人。

translations.literal: Ceng Jun, courtesy name Tinghe, was a native of Jinxian.
translations.idiomatic: Ceng Jun, styled Tinghe, was from Jinxian.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十一年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the eleventh year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the eleventh year of Jiajing.

sentences.zh: 授行人。

translations.literal: He was appointed courier.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a courier in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 擢南京禮科給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to supervising secretary of the Ministry of Rites section at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to supervising secretary in the Ministry of Rites section at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 時四方銀場得不償費，且為盜窟，鈞奏罷之。

translations.literal: At the time silver mines throughout the realm cost more than they yielded and also became bandit lairs; Jun memorialized to abolish them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time silver mines throughout the realm cost more than they yielded and also became bandit lairs; Jun memorialized to abolish them.

sentences.zh: 鈞剛廉疾俗。

translations.literal: Jun was firm, incorrupt, and hated vulgar custom.
translations.idiomatic: Jun was firm, incorrupt, and hated vulgar custom.

sentences.zh: 首劾罷參贊尚書劉龍。

translations.literal: First he impeached and removed Assistant Minister Liu Long.
translations.idiomatic: First he impeached and removed Assistant Minister Liu Long.

sentences.zh: 已，劾翊國公郭勛、禮部尚書嚴嵩。

translations.literal: Soon after he impeached State-supporting Duke Guo Xun and Minister of Rites Yan Song.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he impeached State-supporting Duke Guo Xun and Minister of Rites Yan Song.

sentences.zh: 未幾劾工部侍郎蔣淦、延綏巡撫趙錦。

translations.literal: Before long he impeached Vice Minister of Works Jiang Gan and Yan-sui Governor Zhao Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he impeached Vice Minister of Works Jiang Gan and Yan-sui Governor Zhao Jin.

sentences.zh: 最後劾罷操江都御史柴經。

translations.literal: Finally he impeached and removed River Command Censor-in-Chief Chai Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Finally he impeached and removed River Command Censor-in-Chief Chai Jing.

sentences.zh: 直聲震一時。

translations.literal: His upright voice shook the age.
translations.idiomatic: His upright voice shook the age.

sentences.zh: 出為雲南副使。

translations.literal: He went out as vice commissioner of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice commissioner of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 兩司詣黔國公率廷謁，鈞始正其禮，且厘還所侵麗江民地。

translations.literal: The two commissioners when visiting the Duke of Qian State all bowed in court audience; Jun first corrected the ritual and also restored to Lijiang commoners the land the duke had seized.
translations.idiomatic: When visiting the Duke of Qian State the two commissioners all bowed in court audience; Jun first corrected the ritual and also restored to Lijiang commoners the land the duke had seized.

sentences.zh: 遷四川參政。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice commissioner of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 黔寇亂，撫定之。

translations.literal: Qian bandits rebelled; he pacified and settled them.
translations.idiomatic: Qian bandits rebelled; he pacified and settled them.

sentences.zh: 屢遷河南左布政使。

translations.literal: He rose by stages to Left Administration Commissioner of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Left Administration Commissioner of Henan.

sentences.zh: 三十一年以右副都御史總理河道。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he was made Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and overall supervisor of the waterways.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he was made Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and put in overall charge of the waterways.

sentences.zh: 徐、邳等十七州縣連被水患，帝憂之，趣上方略。

translations.literal: Seventeen prefectures and counties such as Xu and Pi suffered successive flood disasters; the emperor was worried and urgently requested strategic plans.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen prefectures and counties such as Xu and Pi suffered successive flood disasters; the emperor was worried and urgently requested strategic plans.

sentences.zh: 鈞請浚劉伶臺至赤晏廟八十里，築草灣老黃河口，增高家堰長堤，繕新莊等舊閘。

translations.literal: Jun requested dredging from Liulingtai to Chiyan Temple for eighty li, building the Caowan Old Yellow River mouth, raising the long dike at Gaojia Weir, and repairing old sluices such as Xinzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Jun requested dredging from Liulingtai to Chiyan Temple for eighty li, building the Caowan Old Yellow River mouth, raising the long dike at Gaojia Weir, and repairing old sluices such as Xinzhuang.

sentences.zh: 閱數月，工成。

translations.literal: After several months the work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: After several months the work was completed.

sentences.zh: 進工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Right Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 治河四年，入為南京刑部右侍郎。

translations.literal: For four years he managed the river and entered court as Right Vice Minister of Justice at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: For four years he managed the river and entered court as Right Vice Minister of Justice at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 久之，乞歸。

translations.literal: After a long time he requested to return home.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he requested to return home.

sentences.zh: 家居十余年卒。

translations.literal: Living at home more than ten years he died.
translations.idiomatic: He lived at home for more than ten years and died.

sentences.zh: 贈刑部尚書，謚恭肅。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Minister of Justice and given the posthumous title Gongsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Minister of Justice and granted the posthumous title Gongsu.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：鄭嶽等居官，歷著風操。

translations.literal: The eulogy says: Zheng Yue and the others in office over the years displayed moral conduct.
translations.idiomatic: The eulogy says: Zheng Yue and the others in office over the years displayed moral conduct.

sentences.zh: 箴主闕，抑近幸，本末皆有可觀。

translations.literal: They remonstrated about the ruler's faults and restrained close favorites; root and branch all had merit.
translations.idiomatic: They remonstrated about the ruler's faults and restrained close favorites; in fundamentals and particulars all had merit.

sentences.zh: 斤斤奉職，所至以治辦聞，殆列卿之良歟！

translations.literal: Conscientiously fulfilling duty, wherever they went they were known for effective governance—perhaps they were the good among vice ministers!
translations.idiomatic: Conscientiously fulfilling duty, wherever they went they were known for effective governance—perhaps they were the good among vice ministers!

sentences.zh: 唐胄論安南，切於事理。

translations.literal: Tang Zhou's discussion of Annam was close to reason and fact.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Zhou's discussion of Annam was close to reason and fact.

sentences.zh: 歐陽鐸之均田賦，惠愛在民；

translations.literal: Ouyang Duo's equalization of land tax—his kindness and care were with the people;
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Duo's equalization of land tax brought kindness and care to the people;

sentences.zh: 令久於其任，幾與周忱比矣。

translations.literal: had he long remained in office he would nearly have been comparable to Zhou Chen.
translations.idiomatic: had he long remained in office he would nearly have been comparable to Zhou Chen.
